jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Abbott Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD) is looking for a
Cloud Architect
for its global Pharma Division Headquarter based in Allschwil- Basel.

Primary Job Function:

The AA team is on a mission to reshape the entire EPD division around data-driven decision-making. The Cloud Architect collaborates closely with our Data Science team and our product delivery team to make sure that the applications we deploy are built on scalable and robust technology stack. These solutions directly transform the way we produce market and sell our products around the world.

This role focuses on designing and implementing cloud architectures that run AI/GenAI applications in a scalable way across multiple platforms (mobile, web etc..) used by our stakeholders around the world. You help our Engineering team to streamline or automate cloud infrastructure deployment, to enable other development teams to develop and deploy faster focusing on the application core.

Core Job Responsibilities:

Cloud Solution Architecture:

• Design and build, and maintain cloud architectures for scalable, robust AI/GenAI applications across platforms (web, mobile, desktop).

• Leverage cloud-native services to ensure optimal performance, availability, security, and cost efficiency.

• Monitor and optimize cloud infrastructure for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency, leveraging cloud-native monitoring and alerting tools.

• Design and implement load balancing, auto-scaling, and failover strategies to guarantee high availability across all deployed applications.

• Document reference architectures, technical roadmaps, and conduct design reviews with engineering and product teams.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation:

• Develop and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) frameworks and automated workflows, making cloud deployment accessible to developers regardless of IaC expertise.

• Implement robust monitoring, security guardrails, and compliance checks to ensure infrastructure changes are safe, reliable, and aligned with production standards.

Security, Compliance, and Reliability:

• Champion secure cloud designs, ensuring compliance with data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements in coordination with our security team.

• Establish observability, monitoring and disaster recovery mechanisms for all AI/GenAI workloads.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 8+ years of experience architecting and delivering cloud-native applications, including at least 3 years specializing in AI/ML or GenAI workloads.

• Demonstrated experience with monitoring, optimizing, and troubleshooting cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency using modern observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).

• Expertise in AWS cloud services (e.g., ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, OPA, containerization with Docker/Kubernetes).

• AWS Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer etc..) a plus.

• Full stack experience a plus.

• Experience supporting global deployments of multi-platform applications (web, mobile, desktop) across geographies (CDN).

• Proven communication skills. Fluency in English a must.

• Passion for transforming organizations through large scale data

Do you like the sound of this job and think you’ve got what it takes? Then send us your CV today. We look forward to receiving your application as pdf .

(

DESCRIZIONE: Abbott è un leader sanitario globale che aiuta le persone a vivere più pienamente in tutte le fasi della vita. Il nostro portafoglio di tecnologie che cambiano la vita abbraccia lo spettro della salute, con aziende leader e prodotti nella diagnostica, dispositivi medici, nutrizioni e farmaci generici di marca. I nostri 114.000 colleghi servono persone in oltre 160 paesi. Abbott Stabilito Divisione Farmaceutica (EPD) sta cercando un Cloud Architect per il suo quartier generale della Divisione Farmacia globale con sede a Allschwil- Basel. Funzione di lavoro primario: Il team AA è in missione per rimodellare l'intera divisione EPD attorno al processo decisionale basato sui dati. Il Cloud Architect collabora a stretto contatto con il nostro team Data Science e con il nostro team di consegna prodotti per assicurarsi che le applicazioni che distribuiamo siano costruite su uno stack di tecnologia scalabile e robusto. Queste soluzioni trasformano direttamente il modo in cui produciamo mercato e vendiamo i nostri prodotti in tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo si concentra sulla progettazione e l'implementazione di architetture cloud che gestiscono applicazioni AI/GenAI in modo scalabile attraverso piattaforme multiple (mobile, web ecc.) utilizzate dai nostri stakeholder in tutto il mondo. Aiutate il nostro team Engineering a semplificare o automatizzare la distribuzione delle infrastrutture cloud, per consentire ad altri team di sviluppo di sviluppare e distribuire più velocemente concentrandosi sul core dell'applicazione. Responsabilità del lavoro: Cloud Solution Architecture:
• Progettare e costruire e mantenere architetture cloud per applicazioni AI/GenAI scalabili e robuste su piattaforme (web, mobile, desktop).
• Servizi cloud-native per garantire prestazioni ottimali, disponibilità, sicurezza e efficienza dei costi.
• Monitorare e ottimizzare l'infrastruttura cloud per la latenza, il throughput e l'efficienza dei costi, sfruttando strumenti di monitoraggio e allerta cloud-native.
• Progettare e implementare strategie di bilanciamento del carico, auto-scaling e failover per garantire elevata disponibilità in tutte le applicazioni impiegate.
• Architetture di riferimento del documento, roadmap tecniche e condurre recensioni di progettazione con team di ingegneria e prodotto. Infrastrutture come Code & Automation:
• Sviluppare e mantenere l'infrastruttura come framework code (IaC) e flussi di lavoro automatizzati, rendendo l'implementazione cloud accessibile agli sviluppatori indipendentemente dalla competenza IaC.
• Implementare controlli robusti, controlli di sicurezza e controlli di conformità per garantire che i cambiamenti delle infrastrutture siano sicuri, affidabili e allineati agli standard di produzione. Sicurezza, conformità e affidabilità:
• Campione design cloud sicuro, garantendo il rispetto della privacy dei dati, della sicurezza e dei requisiti normativi in coordinamento con il nostro team di sicurezza.
• Stabilire meccanismi di osservazione, monitoraggio e ripristino dei disastri per tutti i carichi di lavoro AI/GenAI. Preferiti:
• Laurea o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria, o una disciplina relativa.
• 8+ anni di esperienza di progettazione e fornitura di applicazioni cloud-native, tra cui almeno 3 anni specializzandosi nei carichi di lavoro AI/ML o GenAI.
• Esperienza dimostrata con monitoraggio, ottimizzazione e risoluzione dei problemi delle infrastrutture cloud per prestazioni, affidabilità e efficienza dei costi utilizzando strumenti di osservabilità moderni (ad esempio CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).
• Competenza nei servizi cloud AWS (ad esempio, ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
• Proficienza in Infrastrutture come Codice (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) e moderne pratiche DevOps (CI/CD, OPA, containerizzazione con Docker/Kubernetes).
• Certificazione AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer ecc.) un plus.
• Piena esperienza stack un plus.
• Esperienza di supporto alle implementazioni globali di applicazioni multi-piattaforma (web, mobile, desktop) attraverso geografie (CDN).
• Prove capacità di comunicazione. Fluenza in inglese un must.
• Passione per trasformare le organizzazioni attraverso dati su larga scala Ti piace il suono di questo lavoro e pensi di avere quello che serve? Allora mandaci il tuo CV oggi. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura come pdf . (

Unsere 114.000 Kollegen dienen Menschen in mehr als 160 Ländern. Abbott Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD) sucht eine Architektur und Architektur für sein weltweites Pharma Division Headquarter mit Sitz in Allschwil- Basel. Primary Job Funktion: Das AA-Team ist auf der Mission, die gesamte EPD-Division um datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung umzugestalten. Der Cloud Architect arbeitet eng mit unserem Data Science Team und unserem Produktlieferteam zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die von uns bereitgestellten Anwendungen auf skalierbaren und robusten Technologiestapeln basieren. Diese Lösungen verwandeln direkt die Art und Weise, wie wir unsere Produkte weltweit produzieren und verkaufen. Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Cloud-Architekturen, die KI/GenAI-Anwendungen auf skalierbare Weise über mehrere Plattformen (Mobile, Web etc.) führen, die von unseren Stakeholdern weltweit genutzt werden. • Überwachen und optimieren Sie die Cloud-Infrastruktur für Latenz, Durchsatz und Kosteneffizienz, nutzen Sie Cloud-native Überwachungs- und Alarmierungstools.

• Champion sichere Cloud-Designs, um die Einhaltung der Datenschutz-, Sicherheits- und regulatorischen Anforderungen in Abstimmung mit unserem Sicherheitsteam zu gewährleisten.
• Einrichtung von Beobachtungs-, Überwachungs- und Katastrophenrückgewinnungsmechanismen für alle AI/GenAI-Workloads. Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:
• Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder einer verwandten Disziplin.
• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung Architekt und Bereitstellung von Cloud-Native Anwendungen, einschließlich mindestens 3 Jahre spezialisiert auf AI/ML oder GenAI Workloads.
• Demonstrierte Erfahrung mit der Überwachung, Optimierung und Fehlerbehebung der Cloud-Infrastruktur für Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz mittels moderner Beobachtungstools (z.B. CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).

DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI : Abbott est un leader mondial des soins de santé qui aide les gens à vivre plus pleinement à tous les stades de la vie. Notre portefeuille de technologies qui changent la vie couvre le spectre des soins de santé, avec des entreprises et des produits de premier plan dans le diagnostic, les dispositifs médicaux, la nutrition et les médicaments génériques de marque. Nos 114 000 collègues servent des gens dans plus de 160 pays. Abbott La Division pharmaceutique établie (DPE) cherche Architecte Cloud pour son siège mondial de la division Pharma basé à Allschwil-Bâle. Fonction principale : L'équipe AA est en mission de remodeler l'ensemble de la division EPD autour de la prise de décision axée sur les données. Le Cloud Architect collabore étroitement avec notre équipe Data Science et notre équipe de livraison de produits pour s'assurer que les applications que nous déployons sont construites sur une pile technologique évolutive et robuste. Ces solutions transforment directement la façon dont nous produisons le marché et vendons nos produits partout dans le monde. Ce rôle est axé sur la conception et la mise en œuvre d'architectures cloud qui gèrent les applications AI/GenAI de manière évolutive sur plusieurs plateformes (mobile, web, etc.) utilisées par nos parties prenantes à travers le monde. Vous aidez notre équipe d'ingénierie à rationaliser ou automatiser le déploiement de l'infrastructure cloud, afin de permettre à d'autres équipes de développement de se développer et de déployer plus rapidement en se concentrant sur le noyau d'application. Responsabilités essentielles au travail : Architecture des solutions en nuage :
• Concevoir et construire des architectures cloud pour des applications AI/GenAI évolutives et robustes sur toutes les plateformes (web, mobile, bureau).
• Tirer parti des services cloud-native pour assurer des performances optimales, disponibilité, sécurité et rentabilité.
• Surveiller et optimiser l'infrastructure cloud pour la latence, le débit et le rapport coût-efficacité, en tirant parti des outils de surveillance et d'alerte cloud-native.
• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'équilibrage des charges, d'auto-échelle et de basculement pour garantir une grande disponibilité dans toutes les applications déployées.
• Documenter les architectures de référence, les feuilles de route techniques et effectuer des examens de conception avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de produits. Infrastructure comme code et automatisation :
• Développer et maintenir l'infrastructure en tant que cadres de code (IaC) et flux de travail automatisés, rendant le déploiement en nuage accessible aux développeurs, indépendamment de l'expertise IaC.
• Mettre en oeuvre une surveillance robuste, des garde-corps de sécurité et des contrôles de conformité pour s'assurer que les changements d'infrastructure sont sûrs, fiables et conformes aux normes de production. Sécurité, conformité et fiabilité :
• Des conceptions cloud sécurisées championnes, garantissant le respect de la confidentialité des données, de la sécurité et des exigences réglementaires en coordination avec notre équipe de sécurité.
• Mettre en place des mécanismes d'observation, de suivi et de reprise après sinistre pour toutes les charges de travail de l'IA/GenAI. Qualifications préférées :
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, ingénierie ou discipline connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'architecture et la fourniture d'applications cloud-native, y compris au moins 3 ans spécialisés dans les tâches AI/ML ou GenAI.
• Expérience démontrée en matière de surveillance, d'optimisation et de dépannage de l'infrastructure cloud pour la performance, la fiabilité et la rentabilité grâce à des outils modernes d'observation (par exemple CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog).
• Expertise en services cloud AWS (par exemple, ECS, EKS, Lambda, SageMaker, S3, IAM, VPC, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
• Compétence en infrastructure comme code (Terraform, CloudFormation, OpenTofu) et pratiques DevOps modernes (CI/CD, OPA, conteneurisation avec Docker/Kubernetes).
• AWS Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, etc.) a plus.
• Pleine expérience de pile un plus.
• Expérience de soutien aux déploiements mondiaux d'applications multiplateformes (web, mobile, bureautique) à travers les géographies (CDN).
• Compétences éprouvées en communication. La fluidité en anglais un must.
• La passion pour la transformation des organisations au moyen de données à grande échelle Vous aimez le son de ce travail et pensez que vous avez ce qu'il faut ? Alors envoyez-nous votre CV aujourd'hui. Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre demande en format pdf . (

jobs.title: Global Medical Director Gastroenterology
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Global Medical Director – Gastroenterology

Abbott | Established Pharmaceutical Division

About Abbott

At Abbott , we believe people live their fullest lives when they are healthy — physically, emotionally, and socially . As a global healthcare leader with more than 107,000 colleagues across 160+ countries , we develop life‑changing medicines and technologies that support health at every stage of life.

Within our Branded Generics business, we make trusted, high‑quality medicines accessible to more than 18 million people every day , particularly in fast‑growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets . Our diverse portfolio spans critical therapeutic areas including Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory , addressing real and often unmet patient needs worldwide.

Abbott is a place where science, purpose, and people come together — and where diverse perspectives and inclusive leadership are essential to delivering better outcomes for patients globally.
Your Impact

As Global Medical Director – Gastroenterology , you will play a central role in shaping Abbott’s global medical strategy for the GI therapeutic area. Working closely with cross‑functional partners, you will help define short‑ and long‑term direction , ensuring medical decision‑making is scientifically robust, patient‑centered, and aligned with global and local needs.

You will be a core member of the Medical Affairs Leadership Team within the Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), contributing your expertise and perspective to strategic decisions across Medical Affairs and Innovation & Development.

What You Will Do

Medical Strategy & Scientific Leadership

• Lead the global medical strategy and activities for the Gastroenterology therapeutic area and assigned products

• Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to translate scientific insight into meaningful medical and patient impact

• Identify unmet medical needs and mid‑ to long‑term opportunities for differentiation, innovation, and value creation

• Continuously evaluate products within scope, identifying portfolio gap‑filling opportunities , including in‑licensing considerations

• Develop therapeutic area medical plans , integrating research priorities, publication strategies, real‑world evidence, and study initiatives

• Prepare Target Product Profiles (TPPs) in partnership with cross‑functional teams

• Drive scientific excellence by reviewing medical literature and generating differentiated ideas (including digital) to strengthen disease management and patient care

Evidence Generation & Governance

• Lead and govern Global Medical Affairs research projects , including IIS, post‑marketing studies, observational and epidemiologic research, Phase IV and RWE studies

• Serve as a member of the Scientific Review Committee , jointly reviewing and approving clinical activities led by Clinical Development

• Ensure high‑quality medical content for digital initiatives aimed at both HCPs and patients

Collaboration, Safety & Compliance

• Build and maintain strong collaboration with regional and local Medical Directors , ensuring alignment between global strategy and local execution

• Establish and sustain trusted, ethical relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and scientific societies

• Act as a core member of the Product Safety Team , overseeing medical safety monitoring and contributing to PSURs, clinical overviews, and risk‑management plans

• As part of the Labeling Sub‑Team , provide medical input and scientific strategies for global and national label changes, including safety‑related updates

• Ensure that all medical and promotional activities comply with global guidelines and regulatory requirements

People Leadership

• Lead and develop a team of two direct reports , fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performing environment

• Attract, mentor, and retain talent through servant leadership , coaching, and emp

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of Abbott Laboratories, is a global leader in life-saving medical technologies. Our innovative systems, developed and manufactured in Zurich, support patients with advanced heart failure. With around 130 colleagues in development, quality, and production, we work together to make a real difference in people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

Process Validations and Equipment Qualification:

• Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to validate processes and qualify equipment.

• Evaluate, review, and approve validation and qualification plans, reports, and risk files.

Non-Conforming Material (NCMR) Handling:

• Manage the complete handling of non-conforming materials (NCMR).

• Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) based on NCMR findings.

• Document, track, and trend NCMRs, ensuring timely and effective corrections.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve non-conformance issues and prevent recurrence.

Root Cause Analysis:

• Lead root cause analysis and problem-solving activities for quality issues.

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances.

• Drive the CAPA process to identify root causes of quality issues, implement corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness.

• Develop preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Analyze and report trends and statistical data from investigations in collaboration with Manufacturing Engineering and company management.

Audit Participation:

• Participate in internal and external audits, providing necessary documentation and support.

• Act as an NCMR Subject Matter Expert (SME) during audits.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, procurement, and manufacturing, to address quality-related issues.

Continuous Improvement:

• Champion continuous improvement initiatives within the quality department.

• Implement best practices and innovative solutions to enhance product quality and process efficiency.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality management, or a related field.

• Experience in medical devices or a similar industry.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in quality engineering, with a focus on NCMR, validations, and CAPA.

• Strong knowledge of quality management systems and regulatory requirements.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and experience with root cause analysis methodologies.

• Proficient in using quality tools and software.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

• In-depth experience in process and test method validation (TMV, IMV, IQ/OQ/PQ) and the application of statistical methods.

• Experience with CAPA processes.

• Proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.

Reporting/Supervisory Structure:

• Reporting line according to the Organizational Chart.

• Demonstrates ability as an individual contributor.

• Works under management direction.

• Fulfills tasks based on delegated competencies given from management.

Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters and help people to live a healthier and fuller life, grow your career, and learn, be your true self. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow

• A workplace in a fortune 500 company and the world’s leading manufacturer of medical devices

• A challenging position in a crisis independent industry

• To become part of a dynamic, highly educated, highly skilled, and motivated team

• Multi-national environment, where we foster the development of our talents within the enterprise

• Competitive compensations and benefits

• A workplace in the heart of Zurich

Please follow our Career site and check for available openings:

I nostri sistemi innovativi, sviluppati e prodotti a Zurigo, supportano i pazienti con insufficienza cardiaca avanzata. • Valutare, rivedere e approvare piani, report e file di rischio di convalida e qualificazione. Movimentazione dei materiali non conformi (NCMR):
• Gestire la movimentazione completa dei materiali non conformi (NCMR).
• Sviluppare e implementare azioni correttive e preventive (CAPA) sulla base dei risultati dell'NCMR.
• Documentare, tenere traccia e definire l'andamento degli NCMR, garantendo correzioni tempestive ed efficaci.
• Collaborare con team interfunzionali per risolvere problemi di non conformità e prevenirne il ripetersi. Analisi delle cause profonde:
• Condurre l'analisi delle cause profonde e le attività di risoluzione dei problemi relativi alla qualità.
• Investigare e risolvere le non conformità.
• Guidare il processo CAPA per identificare le cause profonde dei problemi di qualità, implementare azioni correttive e verificarne l'efficacia.
• Sviluppare misure preventive per evitare il ripetersi. Analisi e reporting dei dati:
• Analizzare e riportare tendenze e dati statistici provenienti da indagini in collaborazione con l'ingegneria di produzione e il management aziendale. Partecipazione agli audit:
• Partecipare agli audit interni ed esterni, fornendo la documentazione e il supporto necessari.
• Agire come esperto in materia NCMR (PMI) durante gli audit. Collaborazione interfunzionale:
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali, tra cui ingegneria, approvvigionamento e produzione, per affrontare le questioni relative alla qualità. Miglioramento continuo:
• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo all'interno del reparto qualità.
• Implementare le migliori pratiche e soluzioni innovative per migliorare la qualità dei prodotti e l'efficienza dei processi. Qualifiche:
• Laurea in ingegneria, gestione della qualità o in un campo correlato.
• Esperienza in dispositivi medici o in un settore simile.
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria della qualità, con particolare attenzione a NCMR, convalide e CAPA.
• Conoscenza approfondita dei sistemi di gestione della qualità e dei requisiti normativi.
• Eccellenti capacità di problem solving ed esperienza con le metodologie di analisi delle cause profonde.
• Competente nell'uso di strumenti e software di qualità.
• Forti capacità comunicative e interpersonali, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente di squadra.
• Esperienza approfondita nella validazione di processi e metodi di prova (TMV, IMV, IQ/OQ/PQ) e nell'applicazione di metodi statistici.
• Esperienza con i processi CAPA.
• Conoscenza della lingua tedesca e inglese sia scritta che parlata. Struttura di reporting/vigilanza:
• Linea di riporto secondo l'Organigramma.
• Dimostra abilità come collaboratore individuale.
• Lavora sotto la direzione della direzione.
• Svolge compiti basati sulle competenze delegate fornite dalla direzione. Lavorare in Abbott In Abbott puoi svolgere il lavoro che conta e aiutare le persone a vivere una vita più sana e piena, far crescere la tua carriera e imparare, essere te stesso. Avrai accesso a:
• Sviluppo di carriera con un'azienda internazionale dove puoi crescere
• Un posto di lavoro in un'azienda Fortune 500 e il principale produttore mondiale di dispositivi medici
• Una posizione stimolante in un settore indipendente dalla crisi
• Entrare a far parte di un team dinamico, altamente istruito, altamente qualificato e motivato
• Ambiente multinazionale, dove promuoviamo lo sviluppo dei nostri talenti all'interno dell'azienda
• Compensi e benefit competitivi
• Un posto di lavoro nel cuore di Zurigo Segui il nostro sito Carriere e verifica le posizioni disponibili: Abbott Lavori | Candidati ora | Opportunità di lavoro in Abbott Laboratories La retribuzione base per questa posizione è N / A. JOB DESCRIPTION: Medical Teacher - Romandie. Abbott Diabetes Care is a global leader in diabetes management and is committed to enabling people with diabetes to lead healthier and healthier lives. Through continuous innovation and constant commitment to quality, Abbott offers state-of-the-art glucose monitoring systems, including the famous FreeStyle LibreTM product line. These products provide accurate and reliable glucose values and help patients and health care professionals better manage diabetes. Abbott's mission is to continuously advance diabetes management through innovative technologies and sustainable support to achieve the best possible global health outcomes. The Medical Educator is a field-based health professional (HCP) position at Abbott Diabetes Care in Switzerland. The role also includes credible transmission of scientific information and professional dialogue with health actors in the assigned geographical area. The position requires close and consistent collaboration with commercial teams, while ensuring full medical independence and maximum scientific integrity. Your responsibilities
• Provide medical and scientific expertise in diabetes to support FreeStyle LibreTM products in Switzerland; collaborate across sectors to develop, align and implement client-level strategies and programs in your sector
• Create and present scientific and medical presentations for health professionals, individually or in a group, face-to-face, online or in recorded form

• Perform internal medico-scientific tasks (e.g. validations, Fair Market Value evaluations, CRM activities B2B) and administrative support
• Develop and maintain a network of scholarly societies, opinion leaders (KOLs), doctors and other relevant health professionals
• Collaborate with DACH, EMEAP and global Medical Affairs teams

• Recognized health professional (e.g. diabetes educator, dietician or doctor) with strong clinical experience in managing people with diabetes

• Strong digital ease and technical understanding

Diese Produkte liefern genaue und zuverlässige Glukosewerte und helfen Patienten und Gesundheitsexperten, Diabetes besser zu behandeln. Die Mission von Abbott ist es, das Diabetesmanagement durch innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Unterstützung kontinuierlich voranzutreiben, um die bestmöglichen globalen Gesundheitsergebnisse zu erzielen. Der Medical Educator ist eine Position als medizinische Fachkraft (HCP) bei Abbott Diabetes Care in der Schweiz. Ihre Verantwortung
• Bereitstellung medizinischer und wissenschaftlicher Expertise im Bereich Diabetes zur Unterstützung von FreeStyle LibreTM-Produkten in der Schweiz; sektorübergreifende Zusammenarbeit bei der Entwicklung, Ausrichtung und Umsetzung von Strategien und Programmen auf Kundenebene in Ihrer Branche
• Erstellen und präsentieren Sie wissenschaftliche und medizinische Präsentationen für Angehörige der Gesundheitsberufe, einzeln oder in einer Gruppe, persönlich, online oder in aufgezeichneter Form

• Durchführung interner medizinisch-wissenschaftlicher Aufgaben (z. B. Validierungen, Marktwertbewertungen, CRM-Aktivitäten B2B) und administrative Unterstützung
• Entwicklung und Pflege eines Netzwerks von wissenschaftlichen Gesellschaften, Meinungsführern (KOLs), Ärzten und anderen relevanten Gesundheitsexperten

• Unterstützen Sie die Auswahl und Umsetzung spezifischer Elemente und Veranstaltungen der FreeStyle AcademyTM Ihre Qualifikationen
• Anerkannte medizinische Fachkräfte (z. B. Diabetes-Pädagoge, Ernährungsberater oder Arzt) mit starker klinischer Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen mit Diabetes

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Zurich, Switzerland | Thoratec Switzerland GmbH (Abbott)

At Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , part of Abbott’s medical device division, we design and manufacture life‑saving heart pump systems used by patients with advanced heart failure around the world. Our products — including CentriMag and HeartMate 3 — are developed and produced at our Zurich site and support patients every day in critical care settings.

With around 140 colleagues across Development, Quality, and Production, our Zurich site combines deep technical expertise with a strong sense of purpose and teamwork. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a EHS Specialist who enjoys collaboration, learning, and leading with care , while contributing to work that truly makes a difference.

About The Role

The EHS Specialist will be responsible for implementing internal and external standards regarding environment, health and safety as well as physical security. The successful candidate will continuously monitor, report, sustain, update and implement new requirements and represent the site’s program to auditors and government officials. In this cross-functional role, you’ll report into the plants head of operations and collaborate with a global EHS team.

Key Responsibilities:

• Ensure accurate and timely reporting of site EHS metrics.

• Develop and lead onsite Emergency Response programs.

• Adapt and rollout global EHS training programs.

• Ensure EHS documentation is accurate and compliant to internal standards and Swiss laws and regulations.

• Act as the point of contact for EHS matters at Abbott Heart Failure’s Zurich site.

• Support Company initiatives as identified by management and in support of Safety Management Systems, Environmental Management Systems (EMS), and other regulatory requirements.

• Promote work safety on site and act as Spezialisten der Arbeitssicherheit (ASA) and facilitate periodic safety audits.

• Organize and manage compliance with Abbott EHS standards via assessment of site programs and documents

• Incorporate duties of a Swiss SiBe (Sicherheitsbeauftragter)

• Work as a team player on a global EHS team

Required Qualifications/Technical Skills:

• Bachelor/Master’s degree in a Science or Engineering discipline

• Professional certification preferred including Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), ISO14001 Lead Auditor

• Min. 3 years of experience in EHS Management ideally in a global, American corporation

• Able to work in a matrix environment with little supervision

• Experience within Med-Tech or pharmaceutical industry desired

• Efficient hands-on project experience, able to get things done

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to adapt it to all levels

• Structured, rigorous and analytical approach

• Excellent command of English with German proficiency preferred, both written and spoken.

Reporting/Supervisory Structure:

• The role reports directly to the Director of Site Operations with a dotted line to the Division Environmental Health and Safety Leader.

Why Join Abbott / Thoratec?

At Abbott, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, respected, and able to grow . You can expect:

• Work that directly improves and saves lives

• Long‑term career development in a global healthcare organization

• A stable, crisis‑resilient industry

• A collaborative, international, and highly skilled team

• A modern workplace in the heart of Zurich

• An inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued

Abbott Jobs | Apply Now | Abbott Laboratories Careers

N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader committed to helping people live their fullest lives at every stage. With a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic medicines, our 114,000 colleagues serve patients in over 160 countries, driving innovation that advances health worldwide.

Within Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), we are expanding our Women’s Health team and are seeking an experienced Global Medical Manager – Women’s Health to support our continued growth.

In this global role, you will partner closely with regional and affiliate Medical teams, Innovation & Development, and Global Marketing, reporting directly to the Global Medical Director of Women’s Health.

Main Responsibilities

• Responsible for specific activities and strategic projects within Medical Affairs for the Women`s Health Portfolio

• Support the Global Medical Director in reviewing, approving and overviewing global and regional medical / clinical studies and publications relevant to the therapeutic area

• In close collaboration with the Global and Regional Marketing Teams, plan and execute prelaunch activities of cross-regional products/brands

• With collaboration of regional medical teams run Key Opinion Leader assessment and identification projects, organize Key Opinion Leaders database, ensure regular updates, identify potential global Key Opinion Leaders, and inform internal stakeholder on potential global Key Opinion Leader candidates

• For geo-expansion of local products, update/upgrade scientific part of registration dossiers in order to get them into approvable standards in other countries.

• Conduct medical assessments on new Licensing & Acquisition opportunities for portfolio expansion

The profile

• Medical Doctor degree and/or PhD in related life sciences with relevant pharmaceutical industry experience in regional or global roles

• At least 5 years of regional or global responsibility for comparable products

• Clinical research experience is an additional merit

• Operating within and cross-functional international /global geographic area

• Strong project management skills across several functional areas

• First international experience, especially in emerging markets is a plus

• Willing to work hands on and be able to think strategically at the same time

• Strong organizational skills, able to communicate on different levels and used to adapt in rapidly changing environment

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Shape the Future of Healthcare with Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader dedicated to helping people live their best lives at every stage. Our portfolio spans life-changing technologies in diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic medicines. With 114,000 colleagues serving patients in 160+ countries , we are committed to advancing health worldwide.

Are you passionate about driving evidence-based strategies that improve patient outcomes? At Abbott’s Established Pharmaceutical Division (EPD) , we are looking for a Senior Manager in Health Economics & Outcomes Research to shape global initiatives that make a real impact.
About the Role

Join us as a Sr Global HEOR & Payer Evidence Lead and help shape access to life-saving therapies in oncology and immunology. This is a unique opportunity to make a global impact while working in a collaborative, inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives.
Reporting to the Director, Global HEOR , you will lead strategic and hands-on initiatives across emerging markets (Latin America, Middle East, Asia-Pacific, China, Russia, India, and Africa). Your work will directly influence patient access and affordability, ensuring innovative treatments reach those who need them most.

What You’ll Do

• Lead with purpose : Oversee HEOR projects with external partners, ensuring scientific rigor and timely delivery.

• Empower teams globally : Co-create country-level HEOR plans and mentor local professionals to build capabilities.

• Drive innovation : Adapt economic models and guide Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies to meet diverse market needs.

• Communicate impact : Translate complex data into clear, compelling value stories for HTA submissions and payer negotiations.

• Collaborate across cultures : Work with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to strengthen global access strategies.

• Champion visibility : Lead publication planning and represent HEOR at international congresses.

About You

• 8+ years’ experience in the biotech, pharma or healthcare sector (incl. consulting) with strong focus in Health Economics, Market Access, or related functions/fields

• Experience across multiple global regions, especially emerging markets

• Deep knowledge of healthcare system and evolving trends of the major HTA countries and Emerging countries

• Strong knowledge of health economic modeling and RWE.

• Proven leadership in cross-functional or cross-country initiatives.

• Advanced degree (MSc, PhD, PharmD, MPH) in health economics, public health, epidemiology, or related field.

• Oncology and/or immunology experience preferred.

• Passion for improving patient access and affordability.

What We Offer

• Inclusive culture : We value diversity and encourage different perspectives to drive innovation.

• Career growth : Leadership development, mentoring, and exposure to strategic decision-making.

• Impactful work : Contribute to therapies that change lives worldwide.

DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI :
Abbott est un chef de file mondial en matière de soins de santé, en tirant parti de la science révolutionnaire et en développant des solutions pour améliorer la santé des gens. Nous nous tournons toujours vers l'avenir et anticipons les changements dans les sciences et la technologie médicales.

TRAVAILLER DANS LA DETTE
Chez Abbott, vous trouverez une tâche qui compte, et vous pourrez évoluer et apprendre, prendre soin de vous et de votre famille, vous réaliser et vivre une vie épanouissante. Abbott vous propose :

• Possibilités de développement dans une entreprise internationale où vous pouvez faire la carrière que vous rêvez de

• Une position difficile dans une industrie indépendante de crise en croissance rapide

• Devenez membre d'une équipe dynamique, hautement qualifiée et motivée

• Hiérarchies plates, mentalité ouverte, appréciatrice et modes de communication efficaces et constructifs

• Un environnement multinational où nous favorisons le développement de nos talents au sein de l'entreprise

• Une entreprise reconnue comme l'une des meilleures grandes entreprises à travailler pour, ainsi que le meilleur lieu de travail pour la diversité, les mères qui travaillent, les dirigeantes et les scientifiques, ainsi que le meilleur employeur en Allemagne

Notre entreprise de neuromodulation comprend des dispositifs implantables compatibles avec la technologie mobile pour aider les personnes souffrant de douleurs chroniques et de troubles du mouvement. Ces thérapies non opioïdes nous permettent d'offrir une thérapie de la douleur interventionnelle aux patients tout au long du continuum de la douleur.

Afin de renforcer notre équipe de neuromodulation en Suisse, nous recherchons

Responsable du développement des entreprises (m/f/d) Neuromodulation – Suisse
bureau à domicile basé en Suisse

Dans cette position, vous serez responsable du développement et de la mise en place de nos thérapies de neuromodulation dans le domaine de la stimulation cérébrale profonde (DBS), du ganglion dorsal et de la radiofréquence (RF) en Suisse. Développez avec les ventes, les spécialistes cliniques et le marketing Vous développerez des stratégies de croissance durable, bâtirez un solide réseau de leaders d'opinion clés et assurerez la mise en œuvre réussie de nos ventes et objectifs du marché.

Tâche

• Développement et mise en œuvre de stratégies de marché et de vente pour le positionnement réussi des thérapies DBS, DRG et RF en Suisse

• Identification, développement et expansion des comptes clients stratégiques pour accroître la pénétration du marché dans DBS

• Segmentation du marché et hiérarchisation des clients cibles appropriés dans DBS &DRG en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de territoire, les spécialistes cliniques et la commercialisation

• Création, maintenance et développement d'un réseau national de leaders d'opinions clés (KOL) dans le domaine de DBS &DRG

• La responsabilité de la stratégie thérapeutique dans le domaine du DRG ainsi que le lancement et la gestion des événements cliniques clients, des ateliers et des tables rondes

• Création et mise en œuvre de plans de compte individuel pour atteindre les objectifs de recettes et de croissance

• Fonctionne comme formateur national et personne de contact spécialisée pour les thérapies DRG et RF en Suisse

• Soutien aux activités européennes de formation et d'éducation en neuromodulation

• Formation et appui professionnel du personnel commercial ainsi que soutien des médecins et des infirmières pendant les implantations et les rendez-vous de suivi

• Analyse de l'évolution du marché, de la concurrence et de la clientèle en vue d'identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires et de nouveaux domaines de croissance

• Mise en œuvre de présentations de produits et représentation de l'entreprise aux congrès, événements spécialisés et foires commerciales

• Assurer une expertise à jour en thérapies, produits, applications cliniques, exigences réglementaires et normes de qualité

• Soutien actif aux activités de commercialisation

jobs.title: Senior Analyst – People & Workforce Analytics
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

The Opportunity
The position works out of our Basel, Switzerland location at the global Headquarters of our medicines business. Our medicines business (Established Pharmaceuticals) is committed to bringing the benefits of our trusted medicines to more people in the world’s fastest-growing countries. Our broad portfolio of high-quality and differentiated branded generic medicines reaches across multiple therapeutic areas including gastroenterology, women's health, cardiometabolic, pain management/central nervous system, and respiratory.

As Senior HR Analyst – People & Workforce Analytics , you’ll have the chance to work with our global enterprise People Analytics team across multiple countries and regions. In this high-impact role, you will transform workforce data into actionable insights that help leaders make smarter talent and organizational decisions.

Working closely with HR leaders, HR Directors, HR Business Partners, and business stakeholders, you will combine advanced analytics , data storytelling , and consultative problem-solving to drive workforce strategy and business outcomes.

What You'll Do

• Deliver data-driven workforce insights across key people metrics, translating complex analyses into clear recommendations that inform strategic decision-making

• Design and maintain scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting solutions using SQL, Power BI, and cloud-based platforms

• Apply statistical and predictive analytics using Python and/or R to identify trends, risks, and opportunities

• Partner with senior HR leadership (Divisional Vice Presidents, Senior HR Directors) to solve workforce challenges through data-driven decision-making

• Leverage automation and AI-enabled tools (e.g., Copilot, Generative AI and automated analytics platforms) to improve efficiency and speed to insight

• Incorporate external benchmarks and labor market insights to contextualize workforce analytics findings

• Connect analytical outputs to strategic workforce priorities such as workforce planning, Scenario modelling, and HR investment decisions

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related HR Domain field

• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Psychology, or related field; master’s degree preferred

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets in cloud environments

• Proficiency in Python and/or R for analytics and statistical modeling

• Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools

• Experience applying statistical methods such as regression, predictive modeling, or classification techniques in workforce contexts

• Demonstrated experience interfacing with and influencing senior HR leadership (Senior Directors, Divisional Vice Presidents), with a high degree of professionalism, business acumen, and executive communication capability.

• Fluent English

Why Join Abbott?

• Career development with an international company where you can grow your career

• Build a unique combination of technical, consulting, and strategic leadership capabilities

• A challenging position where you can influence enterprise workforce and talent decisions on a global scale
Bring your analytical expertise, business curiosity, and passion for data-driven decision-making to help Abbott create a healthier future for people around the world. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

We ask for your understanding that we only consider online applications via our online application portal. Applications by email or post cannot be processed. Original documents will not be returned.

Connect with us at www.abbott.com , on LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/

T

descriptionByLocale.it:
DESCRIZIONE:
Abbott è un leader sanitario globale, creando una scienza innovativa per migliorare la salute delle persone. Stiamo sempre cercando il futuro, anticipando i cambiamenti nella scienza medica e nella tecnologia.

L'opportunità
La posizione funziona fuori dalla nostra sede di Basilea, in Svizzera presso la sede globale del nostro business farmaci. Il nostro business farmaci (Farmaceuticals Established) si impegna a portare i benefici dei nostri farmaci fidati a più persone nei paesi in più rapida crescita del mondo. Il nostro ampio portafoglio di farmaci generici di marca di alta qualità e differenziato raggiunge diverse aree terapeutiche, tra cui gastroenterologia, salute delle donne, cardiometabolic, gestione del dolore/sistema nervoso centrale e respiratorio.

Come Senior HR Analyst – People & Workforce Analytics , avrete la possibilità di lavorare con il nostro team di People Analytics aziendale globale in diversi paesi e regioni. In questo ruolo di alto impatto, si trasformerà i dati della forza lavoro in insights attuabili che aiutano i leader a prendere decisioni intelligenti e organizzative.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i leader delle risorse umane, i direttori delle risorse umane, i partner aziendali delle risorse umane e gli stakeholder aziendali, si unirà a analisi avanzate, storytelling dei dati e problem solving consultivo per guidare la strategia della forza lavoro e i risultati aziendali.

Cosa farai

• Fornisci informazioni sulla forza lavoro basate sui dati sulle metriche delle persone chiave, traducendo analisi complesse in raccomandazioni chiare che informano il processo decisionale strategico

• Progettare e mantenere le soluzioni scalabili di datadotti, dashboard e report utilizzando piattaforme SQL, Power BI e cloud-based

• Applicare analisi statistiche e predittive utilizzando Python e/o R per identificare tendenze, rischi e opportunità

• Partner con leadership senior HR (Divisional Vice Presidents, Senior HR Directors) per risolvere le sfide della forza lavoro attraverso il processo decisionale

• Automazione delle perdite e strumenti abilitati all'IA (ad esempio, Copilota, AI Generativo e piattaforme di analisi automatizzate) per migliorare l'efficienza e la velocità di comprensione

• Incorporare benchmark esterni e approfondimenti del mercato del lavoro per contestualizzare i risultati di analisi della forza lavoro

• Collegare le uscite analitiche alle priorità strategiche della forza lavoro come la pianificazione della forza lavoro, la modellazione dello scenario e le decisioni di investimento HR

Qualifiche

• 5+ anni di esperienza in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Analytics o in un campo di dominio HR

• Laurea in Statistica, Scienza dei dati, Economia, Psicologia, o campo correlato; master’s laurea preferito

• Forte capacità SQL e esperienza di lavoro con grandi dataset in ambienti cloud

• Proficienza in Python e/o R per analisi e modellazione statistica

• Esperienza con Power BI, Tableau o simili strumenti di visualizzazione dati

• Esperienza nell'applicazione di metodi statistici come la regressione, la modellazione predittiva o le tecniche di classificazione in contesti di forza lavoro

• Esperienza dimostrata che interfaccia e influenza la leadership senior HR (Direttori Senior, Vice Presidenti Divisionali), con un alto grado di professionalità, acume aziendale e capacità di comunicazione esecutiva.

• Inglese fluente

Perché unirsi a Abbott?

• Sviluppo di carriera con una società internazionale dove è possibile crescere la tua carriera

• Costruire una combinazione unica di capacità tecniche, di consulenza e di leadership strategica

• Una posizione impegnativa in cui è possibile influenzare la forza lavoro aziendale e le decisioni di talento su scala globale
Porta la tua esperienza analitica, curiosità aziendale e passione per il processo decisionale basato sui dati per aiutare Abbott a creare un futuro più sano per le persone di tutto il mondo. Abbott è un Equal Opportunity Employer, impegnato nella diversità dei dipendenti.

Chiediamo la vostra comprensione che consideriamo solo applicazioni online tramite il nostro portale di applicazioni online. Le domande via e-mail o posta non possono essere elaborate. I documenti originali non saranno restituiti.

Collegati a noi al sito www.abbott.com, su LinkedIn all'indirizzo https://www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/

T

GEMEINSAME BESCHREIBUNG:
Abbott ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen und schafft bahnbrechende Wissenschaft, um die Gesundheit der Menschen zu verbessern. Wir schauen immer in die Zukunft und erwarten Veränderungen in der medizinischen Wissenschaft und Technologie.

Die Chance
Die Position funktioniert von unserem Standort in Basel, Schweiz, am globalen Hauptsitz unseres Arzneimittelgeschäfts aus. Unser Arzneimittelgeschäft (Established Pharmaceuticals) hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Vorteile unserer vertrauenswürdigen Medikamente mehr Menschen in den am schnellsten wachsenden Ländern der Welt zugänglich zu machen. Unser breites Portfolio an hochwertigen und differenzierten Markengenerika erstreckt sich auf mehrere therapeutische Bereiche, darunter Gastroenterologie, Frauengesundheit, Kardiometabolik, Schmerzmanagement / zentrales Nervensystem und Atmung.

Als Senior HR Analyst – People & Workforce Analytics haben Sie die Möglichkeit, mit unserem globalen People Analytics-Team in mehreren Ländern und Regionen zusammenzuarbeiten. In dieser einflussreichen Rolle verwandeln Sie Personaldaten in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse, die Führungskräften helfen, intelligentere Talente und organisatorische Entscheidungen zu treffen.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR-Führungskräften, HR-Direktoren, HR-Geschäftspartnern und geschäftlichen Stakeholdern kombinieren Sie Advanced Analytics, Data Storytelling und beratende Problemlösung, um die Strategie und die Geschäftsergebnisse der Mitarbeiter zu verbessern.

Was du tun wirst

• Liefern Sie datengesteuerte Workforce Insights über wichtige Personalmetriken hinweg und übersetzen Sie komplexe Analysen in klare Empfehlungen, die strategische Entscheidungen beeinflussen

• Design und Pflege skalierbarer Datenpipelines, Dashboards und Berichtslösungen mit SQL, Power BI und Cloud-basierten Plattformen

• Verwenden Sie statistische und prädiktive Analysen mit Python und / oder R, um Trends, Risiken und Chancen zu identifizieren

• Partnerschaft mit Senior HR Leadership (Divisional Vice Presidents, Senior HR Directors) zur Lösung der Herausforderungen der Belegschaft durch datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung

• Nutzen Sie Automatisierungs- und KI-fähige Tools (z. B. Copilot, Generative AI und automatisierte Analyseplattformen), um die Effizienz und Geschwindigkeit von Erkenntnissen zu verbessern

• Integrieren externer Benchmarks und Arbeitsmarkteinblicke zur Kontextualisierung der Ergebnisse von Workforce Analytics

• Verbinden Sie analytische Ergebnisse mit strategischen Prioritäten der Belegschaft wie Personalplanung, Szenariomodellierung und HR-Investitionsentscheidungen

Qualifikationen

• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Analytics oder einem verwandten HR-Domain-Feld

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Statistik, Data Science, Wirtschaft, Psychologie oder verwandten Bereichen; Master-Abschluss bevorzugt

• Starke SQL-Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit großen Datensätzen in Cloud-Umgebungen

• Kenntnisse in Python und / oder R für Analytik und statistische Modellierung

• Erfahrung mit Power BI, Tableau oder ähnlichen Datenvisualisierungstools

• Erfahrung mit der Anwendung statistischer Methoden wie Regression, prädiktiver Modellierung oder Klassifizierungstechniken im Kontext der Belegschaft

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Schnittstelle und Beeinflussung der leitenden HR-Führung (Senior Directors, Divisional Vice Presidents) mit einem hohen Maß an Professionalität, Geschäftssinn und Kommunikationsfähigkeit der Führungskräfte.

• Fließend Englisch

Warum Abbott beitreten?

• Karriereentwicklung mit einem internationalen Unternehmen, in dem Sie Ihre Karriere ausbauen können

• Aufbau einer einzigartigen Kombination aus technischen, beratenden und strategischen Führungsfähigkeiten

• Eine herausfordernde Position, in der Sie Mitarbeiter und Talententscheidungen von Unternehmen auf globaler Ebene beeinflussen können
Bringen Sie Ihre analytische Expertise, Ihr Geschäftsinteresse und Ihre Leidenschaft für datengesteuerte Entscheidungen ein, um Abbott dabei zu helfen, eine gesündere Zukunft für Menschen auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Abbott ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit, der sich der Vielfalt der Mitarbeiter verschrieben hat.

DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI :
Abbott est un chef de file mondial des soins de santé, créant une science révolutionnaire pour améliorer la santé des gens. Nous sommes toujours tournés vers l'avenir, anticipant les changements dans la science et la technologie médicales.

L'opportunité
La position fonctionne à partir de notre Bâle, Suisse emplacement au siège mondial de notre entreprise de médicaments. Notre activité pharmaceutique (Créated Pharmaceuticals) s'engage à apporter les avantages de nos médicaments de confiance à plus de gens dans les pays à croissance rapide. Notre vaste portefeuille de médicaments génériques de marque de haute qualité et différenciés s'étend à de multiples domaines thérapeutiques, y compris la gastroentérologie, la santé des femmes, cardiométabolique, la gestion de la douleur/système nerveux central et respiratoire.

En tant que Senior HR Analyste – People & Workforce Analytics , vous aurez la chance de travailler avec notre équipe mondiale People Analytics dans plusieurs pays et régions. Dans ce rôle à fort impact, vous transformerez les données de la main-d'oeuvre en idées pratiques qui aident les dirigeants à prendre des décisions organisationnelles et des talents plus intelligents.

En étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants des RH, les directeurs des RH, les partenaires opérationnels des RH et les intervenants du monde des affaires, vous combinerez l'analyse avancée, le conte de données et la résolution de problèmes pour orienter la stratégie de l'effectif et les résultats opérationnels.

Ce que tu vas faire

• Fournir des données sur la main-d'oeuvre à partir des indicateurs clés des personnes, en traduisant les analyses complexes en recommandations claires qui éclairent la prise de décisions stratégiques

• Concevoir et maintenir des pipelines de données évolutives, des tableaux de bord et des solutions de reporting utilisant des plateformes SQL, Power BI et cloud

• Appliquer l'analyse statistique et prédictive en utilisant Python et/ou R pour identifier les tendances, les risques et les possibilités

• Établir un partenariat avec les cadres supérieurs des RH (les vice-présidents de division, les directeurs principaux des RH) pour résoudre les problèmes liés à l'effectif grâce à la prise de décisions fondées sur les données

• Tirer parti de l'automatisation et des outils compatibles avec l'intelligence artificielle (p. ex. copilote, plate-formes d'intelligence artificielle génératrice et d'analyse automatisée) pour améliorer l'efficacité et la rapidité de l'information

• Intégrer des repères externes et des perspectives du marché du travail pour contextualiser les résultats de l'analyse des effectifs

• Relier les extrants analytiques aux priorités stratégiques de l'effectif, comme la planification de l'effectif, la modélisation de scénarios et les décisions d'investissement en RH

Compétences

• 5 ans et plus d'expérience dans les domaines de l'analyse des personnes, de l'analyse de la main-d'oeuvre, de l'analyse des données ou d'un domaine RH connexe

• Baccalauréat en statistique, science des données, économie, psychologie ou domaine connexe; maîtrise de préférence

• Fortes compétences SQL et expérience de travail avec de grands ensembles de données dans des environnements cloud

• Compétence en Python et/ou R pour l'analyse et la modélisation statistique

• Expérience avec des outils de visualisation de données Power BI, Tableau ou similaires

• Expérience de l'application de méthodes statistiques telles que la régression, la modélisation prédictive ou les techniques de classification dans le contexte des effectifs

• Expérience démontrée entre les cadres supérieurs des RH (directeurs principaux, vice-présidents de division) et leur influence, avec un haut niveau de professionnalisme, de sens des affaires et de capacité de communication de la haute direction.

• Anglais couramment

Pourquoi rejoindre Abbott ?

• Développement de carrière avec une entreprise internationale où vous pouvez développer votre carrière

• Bâtir une combinaison unique de capacités techniques, de conseils et de leadership stratégique

Within our Established Pharmaceuticals (Branded Generics) business , we provide trusted, high‑quality medicines to over 18 million patients every day , with a strong presence in high‑growth regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets . Our broad portfolio spans essential therapeutic areas including Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory , addressing critical unmet medical needs worldwide.

We are currently looking for a Senior Financial Analyst, Procurement/TPM (Third Party Manufacturing) to join our EPD Headquarters team and help shape the future of our global brands.

Primary Job Function:

This role within the Established Pharmaceuticals Division is responsible for financial planning, analysis, and accounting for Procurement and Third-Party Manufacturing (TPM) within the PROC/TPM Finance organization. Key activities include preparing monthly flash reports, RLBEs, plans, standard and PO pricing updates, and conducting “What-If” analyses to support both operational and strategic objectives.

Responsibilities also include cost accounting and variance analysis on actuals, forecasts, and plans to enable informed decision-making and strategic planning for Procurement and TPM operations. • Perform account balance analysis and ad hoc financial reviews as required.

• Develop and execute comprehensive spend analysis and forecasting strategies to identify and deliver measurable cost-saving opportunities.

• Lead and engage in projects, including ERP enhancements, supply chain analytics, and global demand planning.

• Definire i prezzi standard dei costi, eseguire analisi completa delle variazioni dei prezzi e fornire informazioni strategiche per ottimizzare la redditività e sostenere gli obiettivi a lungo termine.

• Fornire informazioni basate sui dati e raccomandazioni presenti alla leadership senior.

• Gestisci le chiusure di fine mese e fine anno, assicurando una chiara analisi delle variazioni nei conti P&L.

• Eseguire l'analisi del saldo del conto e le recensioni finanziarie ad hoc come richiesto.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie complete di analisi e previsioni di spesa per identificare e fornire opportunità di risparmio di costi misurabili.

• Guidare e impegnarsi in progetti, tra cui miglioramenti ERP, analisi della supply chain e pianificazione globale della domanda.

• Condurre analisi dettagliate dei costi per supportare le decisioni basate sui dati nell'approvvigionamento e nella produzione.

• Supporta la conformità SOX durante gli audit fornendo report e documentazione richiesti.

• Guida gli obiettivi PROC/TPM garantendo trasparenza ed efficienza nei processi transazionali; sensibilizzare le procedure finanziarie tra gli sponsor aziendali.

• Operare in modo indipendente in direzione generale della gestione e rappresentare Procurement/TPM Finance in iniziative cross-divisionali.

• Impegnarsi in frequenti collaborazioni interdivisionali, tra cui CFS, e agire come punto di contatto primario per i progetti assegnati.

• Eseguire analisi ad hoc come richiesto dal controller PROC/TPM e dal business.

• Assicurare il rispetto delle procedure aziendali e dei requisiti normativi in tutti i processi finanziari.

• Corso di laurea (o grado paragonabile) è necessaria la contabilità preferibile, la finanza o l'amministrazione aziendale o il campo relativo.

GEMEINSAME BESCHREIBUNG:
Bei Abbott helfen wir Menschen, gesünder und voller zu leben - physisch, emotional und sozial. Als weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen mit mehr als 107.000 Mitarbeitern in über 160 Ländern entwickeln wir bahnbrechende Technologien und Lösungen, die Gesundheit in jeder Lebensphase unterstützen.

Innerhalb unseres Geschäftsbereichs für etablierte Pharmazeutika (Branded Generics) bieten wir täglich über 18 Millionen Patienten vertrauenswürdige, qualitativ hochwertige Medikamente mit einer starken Präsenz in wachstumsstarken Regionen wie LATAM, APAC, Indien und Emerging Markets. Unser breites Portfolio umfasst wichtige therapeutische Bereiche wie Frauengesundheit, Gastroenterologie, Kardiometabolik, ZNS & Schmerzen und Atemwege und adressiert kritische unerfüllte medizinische Bedürfnisse weltweit.

Abbott ist ein Ort, an dem Wissenschaft, Zweck und Menschen aufeinander abgestimmt sind - und an dem vielfältige Perspektiven und Zusammenarbeit der Schlüssel sind, um den Patienten sinnvolle Auswirkungen zu bieten.

Wir suchen derzeit einen Senior Financial Analyst, Procurement/TPM (Third Party Manufacturing), der unserem EPD-Hauptquartierteam beitritt und die Zukunft unserer globalen Marken mitgestaltet.

Hauptfunktion:

Diese Rolle innerhalb des Geschäftsbereichs Etablierte Pharmazeutika ist für die Finanzplanung, -analyse und -abrechnung für Beschaffung und Drittfertigung (TPM) innerhalb der PROC/TPM-Finanzorganisation verantwortlich. Zu den wichtigsten Aktivitäten gehören die Erstellung monatlicher Flash-Berichte, RLBEs, Pläne, Standard- und PO-Preisupdates sowie die Durchführung von "What-If" -Analysen zur Unterstützung der operativen und strategischen Ziele.

Zu den Verantwortlichkeiten gehören auch die Kostenrechnung und die Varianzanalyse von Istwerten, Prognosen und Plänen, um eine fundierte Entscheidungsfindung und strategische Planung für Beschaffungs- und TPM-Operationen zu ermöglichen. Der Senior Financial Analyst beteiligt sich aktiv an Projektteams und liefert finanzielle Einblicke, um Geschäftsentscheidungen zu treffen.

Kernaufgaben:

• Liefern Sie strategische Finanzanalysen in allen PROC/TPM-Bereichen, einschließlich Standardkosteneinstellungen und damit verbundenen Überprüfungen.

• Unterstützung der PROC/TPM-Planung und der LBE-Updates.

• Definieren Sie Standardkostenpreise, führen Sie eine umfassende Preisvarianzanalyse durch und liefern Sie strategische Erkenntnisse, um die Rentabilität zu optimieren und langfristige Ziele zu unterstützen.

• Bieten Sie datengesteuerte Einblicke und präsentieren Sie Empfehlungen für Führungskräfte.

• Verwalten Sie Monats- und Jahresabschluss, um eine klare Varianzanalyse in P & L-Konten zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie bei Bedarf eine Kontostandsanalyse und Ad-hoc-Finanzüberprüfungen durch.

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung umfassender Ausgabenanalyse- und Prognosestrategien zur Identifizierung und Bereitstellung messbarer Kosteneinsparungsmöglichkeiten.

• Führen und engagieren Sie sich in Projekten, einschließlich ERP-Erweiterungen, Supply Chain Analytics und globaler Bedarfsplanung.

• Führen Sie eine detaillierte Kostenanalyse durch, um datengesteuerte Entscheidungen in Beschaffung und Fertigung zu unterstützen.

• Unterstützen Sie die SOX-Compliance bei Audits, indem Sie die erforderlichen Berichte und Dokumentationen bereitstellen.

• Förderung der PROC/TPM-Ziele durch Gewährleistung von Transparenz und Effizienz bei Transaktionsprozessen; Sensibilisierung der Sponsoren für Finanzverfahren.

• Arbeite unabhängig unter der Leitung des General Managements und vertrete Procurement/TPM Finance in bereichsübergreifenden Initiativen.

• Engagieren Sie sich in häufigen bereichsübergreifenden Kooperationen, auch mit CFS, und fungieren Sie als primärer Ansprechpartner für zugewiesene Projekte.

• Führen Sie Ad-hoc-Analysen durch, wie sie vom PROC/TPM-Controller und vom Unternehmen verlangt werden.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Unternehmensverfahren und regulatorischen Anforderungen in allen Finanzprozessen.

Mindestbildung:

• Bachelor-Abschluss (oder vergleichbarer Abschluss) bevorzugt Buchhaltung, Finanzen oder Business & Administration oder verwandten Bereich ist erforderlich.

• 4+ Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung erforderlich oder eine Kombination aus Ausbildung und Erfahrung, die die erforderlichen Kompetenzen demonstriert.

Mindesterfahrung/Ausbildung erforderlich:

• Kenntnisse in Beschaffung und Finanzen mit starker Liebe zum Detail.

• Erweiterte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Excel (z. B. PivotTables),

DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI :
Chez Abbott, nous aidons les gens à vivre plus sainement et plus pleinement, physiquement, émotionnellement et socialement. En tant que leader mondial de la santé avec plus de 107 000 employés dans plus de 160 pays, nous développons des technologies et des solutions révolutionnaires qui soutiennent la santé à tous les stades de la vie.

Dans le cadre de notre activité Pharmaceuticals (Branded Generics) , nous fournissons des médicaments de haute qualité et fiables à plus de 18 millions de patients chaque jour , avec une forte présence dans des régions à forte croissance telles que LATAM, APAC, Inde et Emerging Markets . Notre vaste portefeuille couvre des domaines thérapeutiques essentiels, notamment la santé des femmes, la gastroentérologie, le cardiométabolisant, le SNC et la douleur, et respiratoire, répondant aux besoins médicaux critiques non satisfaits dans le monde entier.

Abbott est un endroit où la science, l'objectif et les gens s'alignent, et où des perspectives et une collaboration diversifiées sont essentielles pour produire un impact significatif pour les patients.

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d'un analyste financier principal, Approvisionnement/TPM (Tiers fabricants) pour rejoindre notre équipe EPD Siège et aider à façonner l'avenir de nos marques mondiales.

Fonction principale :

Ce rôle au sein de la Division des produits pharmaceutiques établis est responsable de la planification financière, de l'analyse et de la comptabilité des achats et de la fabrication de tiers au sein de l'organisation financière du PROC/PTM. Les principales activités comprennent la préparation de rapports éclairs mensuels, les RLBE, les plans, les mises à jour sur les prix standard et PO, et la réalisation d'analyses sur les questions à l'appui des objectifs opérationnels et stratégiques.

Les responsabilités comprennent également la comptabilisation des coûts et l'analyse des écarts sur les réels, les prévisions et les plans afin de permettre une prise de décisions éclairée et une planification stratégique pour les opérations d'approvisionnement et de GPT. L'analyste financier principal participe activement aux équipes de projet et fournit des renseignements financiers pour guider les décisions d'affaires.

Responsabilités essentielles au travail :

• Effectuer une analyse financière stratégique dans tous les secteurs du PROC/PTM, y compris les paramètres de coûts standard et les examens connexes.

• Soutenir la planification du PROC/PTM et les mises à jour du LBE.

• Définir les prix standard, effectuer une analyse complète des écarts de prix et fournir des indications stratégiques pour optimiser la rentabilité et soutenir des objectifs à long terme.

• Fournir des renseignements fondés sur les données et présenter des recommandations aux cadres supérieurs.

• Gérer les clôtures de fin de mois et de fin d'exercice, en assurant une analyse claire des écarts dans les comptes de P&L.

• Effectuer une analyse de la balance des comptes et des examens financiers ponctuels au besoin.

• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies exhaustives d'analyse et de prévision des dépenses afin de cerner et d'offrir des possibilités mesurables d'économie.

• Diriger et participer à des projets, y compris des améliorations au PGI, des analyses de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la planification de la demande mondiale.

• Effectuer une analyse détaillée des coûts pour appuyer les décisions fondées sur les données en matière d'approvisionnement et de fabrication.

• Appuyer la conformité aux normes SOX pendant les vérifications en fournissant les rapports et les documents requis.

• Favoriser les objectifs du PROC/TPM en assurant la transparence et l'efficacité des processus transactionnels; sensibiliser les promoteurs aux procédures financières.

• Exécuter de façon indépendante sous la direction générale de la direction et représenter les Approvisionnements/Financement du GPT dans les initiatives interdivisions.

• S'engager dans de fréquentes collaborations entre divisions, y compris avec le SCF, et agir comme principal point de contact pour les projets assignés.

For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve.

Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) is looking to recruit a

Director Civil & Constructions Engineering Capital Projects (m/f/d)

PRIMARY JOB FUNCTION

The role reports to Senior Director EPD EHS, Security, and Capital Engineering and will act as a technical leader and subject matter authority within the division and support the execution of ~$220MM capital spend every yea r .
The role, in collaboration with the local site teams, will improve constructability, strengthen site execution discipline, and ensure civil and building work supports safe, compliant, on-time delivery of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) facilities and utilities.

The Director Civil & Constructions Engineering Capital Projects is accountable for setting the divisional standards for civil, structural, architectural, and construction execution for a portfolio of capital projects across all EPD’s manufacturing sites.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provides the necessary technical leadership and subject matter expertise and oversees complex capital projects across all EPD sites to enhance capital execution predictability.

• Defines and deploys enterprise standards, design criteria, and delivery expectations for site development, earthworks, foundations, buildings, cleanroom envelopes, structural systems, underground networks, construction sequencing, etc. for pharmaceutical manufacturing projects.

• Lead civil input into feasibility, concept selection, site master planning, plot plans, utility corridors, logistics strategy, geotechnical assessments, constructability reviews, and early risk identification to avoid late design changes and delays.

• Challenge concepts for simplicity, modularization potential, site access, laydown needs, crane strategy, prefabrication opportunities, and construction phasing to reduce cost, complexity, and schedule risk before projects are sanctioned.

Detailed Engineering:

• Ensure mature, coordinated detailed design packages are issued with clear construction work packs, interface management, clash resolution, permit inputs, and complete specifications to ensure competent field execution and reduce design gaps or rework.

• Lead constructability reviews with engineering, site operations, EHS, quality, and contractors.

• Verify that design reflects real field conditions, shutdown constraints, operational continuity, brownfield tie-ins, material flows, and GMP boundary requirements.

Commissioning, Qualification, Validation (CQV):

• Partner with Quality, Engineering, and site operations to confirm building performance, room classification enclosures, environmental stability, personnel/material flows, and facility compliance elements are stable and sustained for validation execution.

RISPOSTE DI GIOCO

• Condurre l'ingresso civile in fattibilità, la scelta del concetto, la pianificazione del master del sito, i piani di trama, i corridoi di utilità, la strategia logistica, le valutazioni geotecniche, le recensioni di costruzione, e l'identificazione precoce del rischio per evitare cambiamenti e ritardi di progettazione tardivi.
