At Abbott, we're committed to helping people live their best possible life through the power of health. For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve.

Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) is looking to recruit a

Director Civil & Constructions Engineering Capital Projects (m/f/d)

PRIMARY JOB FUNCTION

The role reports to Senior Director EPD EHS, Security, and Capital Engineering and will act as a technical leader and subject matter authority within the division and support the execution of ~$220MM capital spend every yea r .
The role, in collaboration with the local site teams, will improve constructability, strengthen site execution discipline, and ensure civil and building work supports safe, compliant, on-time delivery of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) facilities and utilities.

The Director Civil & Constructions Engineering Capital Projects is accountable for setting the divisional standards for civil, structural, architectural, and construction execution for a portfolio of capital projects across all EPD’s manufacturing sites.

CORE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provides the necessary technical leadership and subject matter expertise and oversees complex capital projects across all EPD sites to enhance capital execution predictability.

• Defines and deploys enterprise standards, design criteria, and delivery expectations for site development, earthworks, foundations, buildings, cleanroom envelopes, structural systems, underground networks, construction sequencing, etc. for pharmaceutical manufacturing projects.

• Basic Engineering & FEP:

• Lead civil input into feasibility, concept selection, site master planning, plot plans, utility corridors, logistics strategy, geotechnical assessments, constructability reviews, and early risk identification to avoid late design changes and delays.

• Challenge concepts for simplicity, modularization potential, site access, laydown needs, crane strategy, prefabrication opportunities, and construction phasing to reduce cost, complexity, and schedule risk before projects are sanctioned.

Detailed Engineering:

• Ensure mature, coordinated detailed design packages are issued with clear construction work packs, interface management, clash resolution, permit inputs, and complete specifications to ensure competent field execution and reduce design gaps or rework.

• Lead constructability reviews with engineering, site operations, EHS, quality, and contractors.

• Verify that design reflects real field conditions, shutdown constraints, operational continuity, brownfield tie-ins, material flows, and GMP boundary requirements.

Commissioning, Qualification, Validation (CQV):

• Ensure buildings, structures, drainage, roadways, access systems, equipment foundations, architectural finishes, and environmental conditions are completed to the required standard and handed over in a controlled manner to support safe commissioning starts.

• Verify that civil and architectural elements affecting GMP compliance, including room finishes, cleanroom shell integrity, pressure envelope readiness, access controls, drainage slopes, hygienic details, and walkdown closure are complete before qualification activities begin.

• Partner with Quality, Engineering, and site operations to confirm building performance, room classification enclosures, environmental stability, personnel/material flows, and facility compliance elements are stable and sustained for validation execution.

• Coach site project managers and engineering leads, create standard playbooks and review checklists, and establish lessons learned across

Der Director Civil & Constructions Engineering Capital Projects ist verantwortlich für die Festlegung der Divisionsstandards für die zivile, strukturelle, architektonische und Bauausführung für ein Portfolio von Kapitalprojekten in allen Produktionsstätten von EPD.

ZUSTÄNDIGKEITEN DES KERNGESCHÄFTS

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Position Overview
The Manager, Int’l Health Systems Integrations supports O-US healthcare organizations in integrating their electronic health and medical records (EMR/HER) systems with Abbott Cancer Diagnostics platforms and workflows. Working directly with hospitals, laboratories, and healthcare IT teams, this role helps establish clinical workflows, streamline data exchange, and support operational goals.

The holder of the role as a key liaison between external healthcare partners and internal Abbott Cancer Diagnostics teams, exchanging on initial implementation topics with customers while also while translating customer systems, workflows, and implementation needs for internal stakeholders. In doing so, the Lead Health Systems Integrations Manager partners closely with colleagues from across Abbott IT Product and Engineering teams as well as Laboratory Operations, Medical Affairs, and Commercial to deliver customer integration initiatives and support ongoing relationship management.

The Manager, Int’l Health Systems Integrations applies their experience with healthcare technology systems (e.g. Dedalus, Cerner, Epic etc.) and knowledge of the healthcare sector to ensure right-sized and customer-centric solutions, all while maintaining compliance with functional and company policies and protocols.

Essential Duties
Include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Serve as a primary point of contact for healthcare organizations and technology partners, helping identify, promote, and support digital health (EMR/HER) integration opportunities and initiatives.

• Partner with account managers, commercial, and marketing teams as a technical subject matter resource in the application and implementation of digital health initiatives.

• Work with our customers (healthcare provider IT, informatics, and operational teams) to support connections between customer systems and Abbott Cancer Diagnostics platforms.

• Lead discussions with customers regarding integration capabilities, workflows, technical requirements, and implementation planning.

• Represent the voice of the customer and help internal teams gain understanding of customer technical environments, operational workflows, and integration needs.

• Support onboarding and relationship management activities involving Epic, Cerner, Dedalus, and other healthcare technology platforms.

• Provide guidance on healthcare data exchange and integration approaches, including HL7, FHIR, APIs, and laboratory orders/results workflows in the context of the customer.

• Coordinate cross-functional internal teams to support customer implementations.

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, simplify connectivity, and enhance customer experience.

• Assist with troubleshooting, issue resolution, and coordination during implementation and post-implementation activities.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with external healthcare IT leaders, informatics teams, laboratory leadership, and operational stakeholders.

• Support creation of customer-facing materials, workflow documentation, and other guidance resources.

• Stay informed on healthcare technology trends, EMR capabilities, and evolving integration approaches within the healthcare, diagnostics, life sciences, and health informatics sectors.

• Deliver regular updates to IT and business leadership as well as other internal stakeholders regarding customer integration activities and strategic opportunities.

• Uphold company mission and values of accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.

• Support and comply with the company's Quality Management System policies and procedures.

• Ability to spend <30% of working time away from work location (including overnight/weekend travel).

Minimum Qualifications

• Fluency in the English language (C1 level or above per CEFR framework) and ability to communicate in English on technical topics.

• Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, information technolo

descriptionByLocale.it:
DESCRIZIONE:
Posizione Panoramica
Il Manager, Int’l Health Systems Integrations supporta le organizzazioni sanitarie O-US nell’integrazione dei sistemi di cartelle cliniche e sanitarie elettroniche (EMR/HER) con piattaforme e flussi di lavoro di Abbott Cancer Diagnostics. Lavorare direttamente con ospedali, laboratori e team IT sanitari, questo ruolo aiuta a stabilire flussi di lavoro clinici, semplificare lo scambio di dati e sostenere gli obiettivi operativi.

Il titolare del ruolo di collegamento chiave tra i partner sanitari esterni e i team interni di Abbott Cancer Diagnostics, scambiandosi su argomenti di implementazione iniziali con i clienti, oltre a tradurre i sistemi dei clienti, i flussi di lavoro e le esigenze di implementazione per gli stakeholder interni. In questo modo, il Lead Health Systems Integrations Manager collabora a stretto contatto con i colleghi di tutti i team di Abbott IT Product and Engineering e le operazioni di laboratorio, Affari medici e Commerciale per fornire iniziative di integrazione dei clienti e sostenere la gestione delle relazioni in corso.

Il Manager, Int’l Health Systems Integrations applica la propria esperienza con i sistemi di tecnologia sanitaria (ad esempio Dedalus, Cerner, Epic ecc.) e la conoscenza del settore sanitario per garantire soluzioni giuste e orientate al cliente, il tutto mantenendo il rispetto delle politiche e dei protocolli funzionali e aziendali.

Dui essenziali
Includi, ma non sono limitati a, i seguenti:

• Servire come punto di contatto primario per le organizzazioni sanitarie e partner tecnologici, aiutando a identificare, promuovere e sostenere le opportunità di integrazione e le iniziative per la salute digitale (EMR/HER).

• Partner con account manager, team commerciali e di marketing come risorsa di materia tecnica nell'applicazione e nell'implementazione di iniziative di salute digitale.

• Lavora con i nostri clienti (fornitori sanitari IT, informatici e team operativi) per supportare le connessioni tra i sistemi clienti e le piattaforme di Abbott Cancer Diagnostics.

• Le discussioni con i clienti riguardano le capacità di integrazione, i flussi di lavoro, i requisiti tecnici e la pianificazione dell'implementazione.

• Rappresentare la voce del cliente e aiutare i team interni a comprendere gli ambienti tecnici dei clienti, i flussi di lavoro operativi e le esigenze di integrazione.

• Supporta le attività di gestione dei rapporti e di bordo che coinvolgono Epic, Cerner, Dedalus e altre piattaforme di tecnologia sanitaria.

• Fornire indicazioni sugli approcci di scambio e integrazione dei dati sanitari, tra cui HL7, FHIR, API e workflow di ordini/risultati di laboratorio nel contesto del cliente.

• Coordinate i team interni interfunzionali per supportare le implementazioni dei clienti.

• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare i flussi di lavoro, semplificare la connettività e migliorare l'esperienza del cliente.

• Assistere con la risoluzione dei problemi, la risoluzione dei problemi e il coordinamento durante le attività di implementazione e post-implementazione.

• Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con i leader IT sanitari esterni, team informatici, leadership di laboratorio e stakeholder operativi.

• Supporta la creazione di materiali orientati al cliente, la documentazione del flusso di lavoro e altre risorse di orientamento.

• Rimani informato sulle tendenze della tecnologia sanitaria, sulle capacità EMR e sugli approcci di integrazione in evoluzione all'interno dei settori della sanità, della diagnostica, delle scienze della vita e dell'informatica sanitaria.

• Fornisci aggiornamenti regolari alla leadership IT e business, nonché altri stakeholder interni per quanto riguarda le attività di integrazione dei clienti e le opportunità strategiche.

• Sostenere la missione aziendale e i valori di responsabilità, innovazione, integrità, qualità e lavoro di squadra.

• Sostenere e rispettare le politiche e le procedure del Quality Management System dell'azienda.

• Capacità di trascorrere <30% del tempo di lavoro lontano dalla posizione di lavoro (compreso viaggio di notte / week-end).

Qualifiche minime

• Fluenza nella lingua inglese (livello C1 o superiore per quadro CEFR) e capacità di comunicare in inglese su argomenti tecnici.

• Corso di laurea in sanità, informatica technolo

Lageübersicht
Der Manager, Int'l Health Systems Integrations unterstützt O-US-Gesundheitsorganisationen bei der Integration ihrer elektronischen Gesundheits- und Krankenakten (EMR / HER) Systeme mit Abbott Cancer Diagnostics Plattformen und Workflows. Der Inhaber der Rolle als Schlüsselverbindung zwischen externen Gesundheitspartnern und internen Teams von Abbott Cancer Diagnostics, tauscht sich über erste Implementierungsthemen mit Kunden aus und übersetzt gleichzeitig Kundensysteme, Workflows und Implementierungsbedürfnisse für interne Stakeholder. Dabei arbeitet der Lead Health Systems Integrations Manager eng mit Kollegen aus allen Abbott IT-Produkt- und Engineering-Teams sowie Laborbetrieb, Medical Affairs und Commercial zusammen, um Kundenintegrationsinitiativen zu liefern und das laufende Beziehungsmanagement zu unterstützen.

Der Manager, Int’l Health Systems Integrations, wendet seine Erfahrung mit Technologiesystemen im Gesundheitswesen (z. B. Dedalus, Cerner, Epic usw.) und seine Kenntnisse des Gesundheitssektors an, um richtige und kundenorientierte Lösungen zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der funktionalen Richtlinien und Protokolle zu gewährleisten.

Wesentliche Pflichten
Dazu gehören unter anderem:

• Dienen Sie als primäre Anlaufstelle für Gesundheitsorganisationen und Technologiepartner und helfen Sie dabei, Integrationsmöglichkeiten und -initiativen für digitale Gesundheit (EMR / HER) zu identifizieren, zu fördern und zu unterstützen.

• Partner mit Account Managern, Werbe- und Marketingteams als technische Ressource bei der Anwendung und Umsetzung von digitalen Gesundheitsinitiativen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit unseren Kunden (Gesundheitsdienstleister IT, Informatik und operative Teams) zusammen, um die Verbindungen zwischen Kundensystemen und Abbott Cancer Diagnostics-Plattformen zu unterstützen.

• Führen Sie Gespräche mit Kunden über Integrationsmöglichkeiten, Workflows, technische Anforderungen und Implementierungsplanung.

• Repräsentieren Sie die Stimme des Kunden und helfen Sie internen Teams, technische Umgebungen, operative Workflows und Integrationsanforderungen des Kunden zu verstehen.

• Unterstützung von Onboarding- und Beziehungsmanagement-Aktivitäten mit Epic, Cerner, Dedalus und anderen Plattformen für Gesundheitstechnologie.

• Bereitstellung von Leitlinien für den Austausch und die Integration von Gesundheitsdaten, einschließlich HL7, FHIR, APIs und Laboraufträgen/Ergebnissen im Kontext des Kunden.

• Koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifende interne Teams, um Kundenimplementierungen zu unterstützen.

DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI :
Aperçu de la position
Le gestionnaire, Intégrations de systèmes de santé Int=l aide les organismes de santé O-US à intégrer leurs systèmes électroniques de santé et de dossiers médicaux (EMR/HER) à Abbott Cancer Diagnostics plates-formes et flux de travail. En travaillant directement avec les hôpitaux, les laboratoires et les équipes informatiques de soins de santé, ce rôle contribue à établir les flux de travail cliniques, à rationaliser l'échange de données et à soutenir les objectifs opérationnels.

Le titulaire du rôle de liaison clé entre les partenaires externes de soins de santé et les équipes internes Abbott Cancer Diagnostics, échange sur les sujets de mise en œuvre initiale avec les clients tout en traduisant les systèmes clients, les flux de travail et les besoins de mise en œuvre pour les intervenants internes. Ce faisant, le gestionnaire principal des intégrations de systèmes de santé collabore étroitement avec des collègues de l'ensemble des équipes de produits et d'ingénierie de la TI d'Abbott, ainsi qu'avec les opérations de laboratoire, les affaires médicales et commerciales, afin d'offrir des initiatives d'intégration de la clientèle et de soutenir la gestion continue des relations.

Le gestionnaire, Intégrations de systèmes de santé Int=l applique leur expérience avec les systèmes de technologie de la santé (par exemple Dedalus, Cerner, Epic, etc.) et la connaissance du secteur de la santé pour assurer des solutions adaptées et centrées sur le client, tout en maintenant le respect des politiques et des protocoles fonctionnels et d'entreprise.

Fonctions essentielles
Inclure, sans s'y limiter, les éléments suivants :

• Servir de point de contact principal pour les organismes de santé et les partenaires technologiques, aidant à identifier, promouvoir et soutenir les possibilités et les initiatives d'intégration en matière de santé numérique (EMR/HER).

• Établir des partenariats avec les gestionnaires de comptes, les équipes commerciales et de marketing en tant que ressource technique dans l'application et la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives en santé numérique.

• Travailler avec nos clients (fournisseur de soins de santé IT, informatique et équipes opérationnelles) pour soutenir les connexions entre les systèmes clients et les plateformes Abbott Cancer Diagnostics.

• Diriger les discussions avec les clients au sujet des capacités d'intégration, des flux de travail, des exigences techniques et de la planification de la mise en oeuvre.

• Représenter la voix du client et aider les équipes internes à comprendre les environnements techniques du client, les flux de travail opérationnels et les besoins d'intégration.

• Soutien aux activités d'embarquement et de gestion des relations impliquant Epic, Cerner, Dedalus et d'autres plateformes technologiques de soins de santé.

• Fournir des conseils sur les approches d'échange et d'intégration des données de soins de santé, y compris HL7, FHIR, API, et les flux de travail commandes/résultats de laboratoire dans le contexte du client.

• Coordonner les équipes internes interfonctionnelles pour soutenir la mise en œuvre des clients.

• Identifier les possibilités d'améliorer les flux de travail, de simplifier la connectivité et d'améliorer l'expérience client.

• Aider à résoudre les problèmes, à résoudre les problèmes et à coordonner les activités de mise en oeuvre et de post-mise en oeuvre.

• Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les chefs de file en TI des soins de santé externes, les équipes informatiques, le leadership en laboratoire et les intervenants opérationnels.

• Soutenir la création de matériel destiné aux clients, la documentation sur les flux de travail et d'autres ressources d'orientation.

• Restez informé des tendances des technologies de la santé, des capacités de REM et de l'évolution des approches d'intégration dans les secteurs des soins de santé, du diagnostic, des sciences de la vie et de l'informatique de la santé.

• Fournir régulièrement des mises à jour au leadership des TI et des entreprises ainsi qu'à d'autres intervenants internes concernant les activités d'intégration des clients et les possibilités stratégiques.

• Maintenir la mission de l'entreprise et les valeurs de responsabilité, d'innovation, d'intégrité, de qualité et de travail d'équipe.

• Soutenir et respecter les politiques et procédures du système de gestion de la qualité de l'entreprise.

• Capacité de passer moins de 30 % du temps de travail à l'extérieur du lieu de travail (y compris les déplacements de nuit ou de fin de semaine).

Qualités minimales

• Connaissance de l'anglais (niveau C1 ou supérieur par cadre du CECR) et aptitude à communiquer en anglais sur des sujets techniques.

• Licence en soins de santé, information technolo

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
About Abbott
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Structural Heart Business Mission:
Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life through the design and provision of device and management solutions for the treatment of structural heart disease.

Abbott's Structural Heart division in Switzerland is looking for a

Country Manager Structural Heart Switzerland
based in Switzerland

The Opportunity
The Country Manager Structural Heart Switzerland is responsible for maximizing revenue growth, profitability, and market penetration across Abbott's Structural Heart business in Switzerland. This leadership role owns the country P&L and is accountable for delivering top-line sales performance, managing operating expenses in line with budget expectations, and leading a high-performing commercial organization.
The Country Manager will develop and execute strategic growth plans, strengthen relationships with key customers and healthcare stakeholders, and ensure organizational excellence through effective leadership, talent development, and operational execution. Working closely with regional and global partners, this individual will position Abbott as the partner of choice in Structural Heart therapies while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, ethics, and patient focus.

What You'll Work On

• Develop and execute country business plans designed to achieve sales growth, profitability objectives, and market share expansion.

• Establish sales targets based on market opportunities, customer needs, and strategic priorities.

• Define and implement sales strategies and tactical plans to maximize market penetration across the Structural Heart portfolio.

• Own and manage all aspects of the country P&L, ensuring achievement of revenue, profitability, and expense objectives.

• Monitor SG&A expenditures and variable selling costs to optimize business performance and profit margins.

• Identify, assess, and capitalize on market opportunities while proactively managing business risks.

• Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team that consistently delivers against operating plans and strategic objectives.

• Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with physicians, hospital administrators, healthcare stakeholders, key opinion leaders, and professional organizations.

• Ensure Abbott maintains a strong presence and reputation within the Swiss Structural Heart market.

• Partner with regional and global stakeholders to align local execution with broader business strategies.

• Drive effective resource allocation and organizational effectiveness to maximize business performance.

• Take proactive actions to improve operational efficiency and minimize unnecessary costs.

• Ensure full compliance with Abbott policies, quality standards, industry regulations, and local legal requirements.

• Serve as a role model for Abbott's values and Code of Conduct in all business interactions.

• Represent Abbott at customer meetings, industry events, scientific congresses, and professional forums.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

• Significant commercial leadership experience within the medical device, healthcare, cardiovascular, or related industry.

• Demonstrated experience managing revenue growth and business performance within a complex healthcare environment.

• Proven track record of developing and executing successful sales strategies and commercial plans.

• Experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing sales and commercial teams.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess market dynamics, identify opportunities, and mitigate risks.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Senior NPI Engineer – New Product Introduction

Shape the Future of Mechanical Circulatory Support

Join Abbott's Heart Failure business and play a key role in bringing the next generation of the CentriMag ™ Circulatory Support System from development into global manufacturing.

As a Senior NPI Engineer , you will lead the industrialization, validation, and manufacturing scale-up of complex electromechanical medical devices that directly support critically ill cardiac patients. This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence product design, manufacturing strategy, supplier readiness, and production ramp-up from early development through commercial launch.

A unique aspect of this position is the close collaboration between our teams in Zurich, Switzerland and Pleasanton, California . Working as part of a highly integrated global organization, you will partner with experts across R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and Supplier Engineering to bring innovative technologies to market.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working hands-on with manufacturing processes, and turning innovative concepts into scalable products that improve patients' lives, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

New Product Introduction & Manufacturing Scale-Up

• Lead manufacturing process development, design transfer, and manufacturing readiness activities from concept through commercial launch.

• Develop, characterize, optimize , and scale manufacturing processes for assembly, calibration, testing, inspection, and packaging.

• Partner with R&D to drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) improvements.

• Translate product requirements into manufacturing requirements, process specifications, equipment requirements, and control strategies.

• Support engineering builds, pilot builds, clinical builds, and production ramp-up activities.

Process Validation & Technical Leadership

• Own process validation activities (IQ/OQ/PQ) for internal manufacturing processes and supplier operations.

• Develop validation plans, protocols, reports, and statistical justifications.

• Lead process characterization activities to ensure robust and capable manufacturing processes.

• Develop and maintain PFMEAs, control plans, CTQs , IPCs , manufacturing specifications, and work instructions.

• Support equipment qualification and test method validation activities.

Supplier & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Serve as the technical manufacturing lead for external suppliers and manufacturing partners.

• Evaluate supplier process flows, PFMEAs, control plans, validation strategies, and manufacturing readiness.

• Drive alignment between internal and supplier manufacturing processes to enable successful commercialization.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in Zurich and Pleasanton to resolve technical challenges and support project milestones.

• Support root cause investigations, yield improvement initiatives, CAPA activities, and ongoing process optimization.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering , Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

• 7 + years of experience in New Product Introduction (NPI), Manufacturing Engineering, Process Development, Industrialization, or Design Transfer within a regulated industry.

• Experience developing and validating manufacturing processes for complex electromechanical products.

• Strong knowledge of process validation methodologies (IQ/OQ/PQ), manufacturing readiness, and design transfer.

• Experience developing manufacturing specifications, process documentation, PFMEAs, control plans, CTQs , and IPCs .

• Hands-on experience supporting engineering builds, pilot production, and manufacturing floor activities.

• Experience collaborating with external suppliers and contract manufacturers.

Questo ruolo sarà un contributo fondamentale per la transizione di dispositivi medici complessi e elettromeccanici dalla progettazione attraverso la produzione convalidata, sia in casa che in fornitori esterni. Il candidato ideale porta mani ‐ sull'esperienza nello sviluppo del processo , la validazione del processo , e la prontezza di fabbricazione per apparecchiature di capitale contenenti elettronica, display, interfacce utente (bottoni, touchscreen, connettori), e motori elettromagnetici , all'interno di un ambiente di dispositivo medico regolamentato. Con il tuo lavoro, ti assicurerai che questi prodotti salvavita restino all'avanguardia nell'innovazione e soddisfino i più elevati standard del nostro settore. Nel vostro ruolo sarete interfacciati e collaborando con squadre interfunzionali negli uffici di Zurigo e Stati Uniti. Principali responsabilità Nuovo prodotto Introduzione e sviluppo dei processi
• Sviluppo del processo di produzione dell'azionamento dalle fasi iniziali di progettazione attraverso il lancio commerciale per dispositivi medici elettromeccanici complessi.
• Sviluppare, caratterizzare e ottimizzare i processi produttivi per le attrezzature di capitale, comprese le operazioni di montaggio, test, calibrazione e confezionamento.
• Support Design per le attività di produzione (DFM) in collaborazione con R&D, Quality e Operations.

• Attività di validazione del proprio processo (IQ/OQ/PQ) per apparecchiature e processi di fornitori interni in conformità alle procedure ISO 13485 e Abbott.
• Autori piani di convalida, protocolli e report di sintesi.
• Creare la documentazione di produzione, compresi i requisiti di fabbricazione, le specifiche dell'attrezzatura e del processo, le procedure di fabbricazione / istruzioni di lavoro / IPC, metodi di prova e PFME. Produzione e collaborazione dei fornitori
• Servire come interfaccia tecnica tra Abbott e fornitori esterni che sviluppano sotto-assemblaggi o effettuano passi di produzione outsourced.
• Flussi di processo del fornitore di revisione, PFMEAs, piani di controllo e protocolli di convalida.
• Allineare processi produttivi interni ed esterni per una produzione efficiente. Qualificazioni richieste
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria manifatturiera, ingegneria elettrica, o una disciplina tecnica correlata.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nel dispositivo medico NPI, ingegneria manifatturiera o sviluppo di processo.
• ProprietÃ nello sviluppo e nella convalida dei processi produttivi e degli strumenti per apparecchiature elettromeccaniche o di capitale medicali.
• Forte conoscenza di lavoro della validazione dei processi (IQ/OQ/PQ) e degli ambienti di produzione regolamentati.
• Esperienza creando requisiti, specifiche e procedure di produzione, tra cui lo sviluppo / definizione CTQ e IPC
• Esperienza a mano sul pavimento di produzione per supportare la costruzione di ingegneria/pilota.
• Esperienza di collaborazione e gestione di fornitori esterni per processi produttivi o sotto-assemblaggi.
• Forte capacità di scrittura e comunicazione tecnica; capacità di collaborare con un team di progetto interfunzionale (R&D, Qualità, Regolazione, ecc.)
• La competenza inglese è richiesta (l'inglese è utilizzato in riunioni e tutta la documentazione) Qualificazioni predestinate
• Esperienza con dispositivi medici/attrezzatura contenenti componenti elettronici, motori, display LCD e interfaccia utente
• Proficienza utilizzando statistiche, tra cui gage R&R, DOE, studi di capacità (Cp/Cpk), e altre analisi per garantire la misurazione e la robustezza del processo
• Esperienza con le metodologie Lean Manufacturing e/o Six Sigma
• Esperienza che supporta la produzione di ramp-up e l'ingegneria di supporto dopo il lancio del prodotto

JOB DESCRIPTION:
About Abbott
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.
In Abbott’s Heart Failure (HF) business, we’re developing solutions to diagnose, monitor and manage heart failure, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

Abbott's Heart Failure division in Switzerland is looking for a

Territory Manager Heart Failure/CardioMEMS - German-speaking Switzerland
home-based, ideally located in the assigned territory within Switzerland

The Opportunity
The Territory Manager is responsible for driving sustainable growth of Abbott’s Heart Failure business through the expansion of CardioMEMS therapy adoption, the development of implanting and referring networks, and the optimization of remote patient monitoring pathways across the territory. This role is focused on scaling therapy adoption, building strong referral ecosystems, and integrating digital monitoring solutions into clinical practice. Working closely with stakeholders across hospital and outpatient settings, the Territory Manager will position Abbott as a trusted partner in heart failure management while delivering commercial growth and improving patient access to innovative therapies.

What You’ll Work On

• Acting independently within your territory, you will be responsible for achieving sales targets through volume growth, new account activation, and expansion of CardioMEMS utilization.

• You will develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans focused on increasing adoption of CardioMEMS therapy and remote monitoring solutions.

• You will build and maintain strong relationships with heart failure cardiologists, heart failure clinics, hospital administrators, and other key stakeholders.

• You will lead pricing, contracting, and value-based discussions with customers while identifying opportunities to expand existing business.

• You will drive therapy adoption within existing implanting centers and heart failure clinics while identifying and developing new growth accounts.

• You will develop and expand referral networks across community and hospital settings, engaging referring physicians and heart failure clinics to improve patient access.

• You will map, optimize, and support patient pathways that enable earlier identification, monitoring, and management of heart failure patients.

• You will collaborate with clinical and non-clinical stakeholders to develop business cases supporting the introduction and implementation of the CardioMEMS service.

• You will analyze market opportunities, patient populations, and therapy gaps to identify strategic growth opportunities across the territory.

• You will deliver clinical education, product training, and therapy awareness programs to healthcare professionals and support peer-to-peer education initiatives.

• You will support procedures and therapy implementation, ensuring successful integration of CardioMEMS into heart failure clinic workflows and care pathways.

• You will provide ongoing technical, clinical, and operational support to customers and enable clinicians to leverage hemodynamic data for optimized patient management.

• You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Clinical, and Digital teams to execute campaigns, educational programs, product launches, and market development initiatives.

• You will maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, CRM reporting, and ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

• You will represent Abbott at customer meetings, scientific workshops, educational events, and relevant national and international congresses.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field.

• Proven experience in medical device, healthcare, or cardiovascular sales.

• Experience in heart failure management, cardiovascul

DESCRIZIONE:
Informazioni su Abbott
Abbott è un leader sanitario globale, creando una scienza innovativa per migliorare la salute delle persone. Stiamo sempre cercando il futuro, anticipando i cambiamenti nella scienza medica e nella tecnologia.
Nell’attività di Abbott’s Heart Fall (HF), stiamo sviluppando soluzioni per diagnosticare, monitorare e gestire l’insufficienza cardiaca, permettendo alle persone di ripristinare la loro salute e andare avanti con la loro vita.

La divisione Heart Fall di Abbott in Svizzera sta cercando un

Gestione del territorio Insufficienza cardiaca/CardioMEMS - Svizzera tedesca
home-based, idealmente situato nel territorio assegnato all'interno della Svizzera

L'opportunità
Il Territorio Manager è responsabile della crescita sostenibile del business di Abbott’s Heart Fall attraverso l’espansione dell’adozione della terapia CardioMEMS, lo sviluppo delle reti di impianto e di riferimento e l’ottimizzazione dei percorsi di monitoraggio remoto dei pazienti in tutto il territorio. Questo ruolo è focalizzato sull'adozione della terapia di scaling, la costruzione di ecosistemi di riferimento forti e l'integrazione di soluzioni di monitoraggio digitale nella pratica clinica. Lavorando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate in ambienti ospedalieri e ambulatoriali, il Territorio Manager posiziona Abbott come partner affidabile nella gestione dei guasti cardiaci, offrendo allo stesso tempo la crescita commerciale e migliorando l'accesso dei pazienti a terapie innovative.

Cosa lavorerai

• Agendo in modo indipendente all'interno del vostro territorio, sarete responsabili del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita attraverso la crescita del volume, l'attivazione di nuovi account e l'espansione dell'utilizzo di CardioMEMS.

• Svilupperai ed eseguirai piani di territorio e account completi focalizzati sull'adozione crescente di soluzioni di terapia CardioMEMS e monitoraggio remoto.

• Si costruirà e manterrà relazioni forti con cardiologi di insufficienza cardiaca, cliniche di insufficienza cardiaca, amministratori ospedalieri e altri stakeholder chiave.

• Potrai condurre i prezzi, la contrazione e le discussioni basate sul valore con i clienti, identificando le opportunità di espandere il business esistente.

• Potrai guidare l'adozione della terapia all'interno dei centri di impianto esistenti e cliniche di insufficienza cardiaca durante l'identificazione e lo sviluppo di nuovi conti di crescita.

• Si svilupperà ed espanderà le reti di riferimento attraverso le impostazioni della comunità e dell'ospedale, coinvolgendo medici di riferimento e cliniche di insufficienza cardiaca per migliorare l'accesso dei pazienti.

• Potrai mappare, ottimizzare e supportare i percorsi dei pazienti che consentono l'identificazione, il monitoraggio e la gestione di pazienti insufficienza cardiaca.

• Collaborerai con gli stakeholder clinici e non clinici per sviluppare casi di business che supportano l'introduzione e l'implementazione del servizio CardioMEMS.

• Analizzerai opportunità di mercato, popolazioni di pazienti e lacune terapeutiche per identificare opportunità di crescita strategica in tutto il territorio.

• Potrai fornire corsi di formazione clinica, formazione dei prodotti e programmi di consapevolezza della terapia per i professionisti sanitari e sostenere iniziative di educazione peer-to-peer.

• Sosterrete le procedure e l'implementazione della terapia, assicurando l'integrazione riuscita di CardioMEMS in flussi di lavoro clinica di insufficienza cardiaca e percorsi di cura.

• Fornirai supporto tecnico, clinico e operativo continuo ai clienti e consentirà ai medici di sfruttare i dati emodinamici per una gestione ottimizzata dei pazienti.

• Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i team Marketing, Clinical e Digital per eseguire campagne, programmi educativi, lancio di prodotti e iniziative di sviluppo di mercato.

• Si manterrà accurata gestione delle pipeline, previsione, report CRM e garantire la conformità alle politiche aziendali e requisiti normativi.

• Tu rappresenterai Abbott alle riunioni dei clienti, ai workshop scientifici, agli eventi educativi e ai congressi nazionali e internazionali rilevanti.

Qualificazioni richieste

• Laurea in Business, Scienze della vita, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo.

• Esperienza comprovata in dispositivi medici, assistenza sanitaria o vendite cardiovascolari.

• Esperienza nella gestione dei guasti cardiaci, cardiovascul

Über Abbott
Abbott ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen und schafft bahnbrechende Wissenschaft, um die Gesundheit der Menschen zu verbessern. Wir schauen immer in die Zukunft und erwarten Veränderungen in der medizinischen Wissenschaft und Technologie.
Im Unternehmen von Abbott Heart Failure (HF) entwickeln wir Lösungen zur Diagnose, Überwachung und Verwaltung von Herzinsuffizienz, die es den Menschen ermöglichen, ihre Gesundheit wiederherzustellen und ihr Leben fortzusetzen.

Abbotts Heart Failure Division in der Schweiz sucht eine

Territory Manager Heart Failure/CardioMEMS - Deutschsprachige Schweiz
Home-based, ideal gelegen im zugewiesenen Gebiet innerhalb der Schweiz

Die Chance
Der Territory Manager ist dafür verantwortlich, das nachhaltige Wachstum des Herzinsuffizienzgeschäfts von Abbott durch die Erweiterung der CardioMEMS-Therapie, die Entwicklung von Implantations- und Referenznetzwerken und die Optimierung der Fernüberwachungswege für Patienten im gesamten Gebiet voranzutreiben. Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Skalierung der Therapieannahme, den Aufbau starker Empfehlungsökosysteme und die Integration digitaler Überwachungslösungen in die klinische Praxis. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Interessengruppen in Krankenhäusern und ambulanten Umgebungen wird der Territory Manager Abbott als vertrauenswürdigen Partner im Herzinsuffizienzmanagement positionieren und gleichzeitig kommerzielles Wachstum erzielen und den Zugang der Patienten zu innovativen Therapien verbessern.

Woran Sie arbeiten werden

• Wenn Sie in Ihrem Gebiet unabhängig handeln, sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, Umsatzziele durch Volumenwachstum, Aktivierung neuer Konten und Erweiterung der CardioMEMS-Auslastung zu erreichen.

• Sie entwickeln und führen umfassende Gebiets- und Kontopläne aus, die sich auf die zunehmende Einführung von CardioMEMS-Therapie- und Fernüberwachungslösungen konzentrieren.

• Sie werden starke Beziehungen zu Herzinsuffizienzkardiologen, Herzinsuffizienzkliniken, Krankenhausverwaltern und anderen wichtigen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen.

• Sie führen Preis-, Vertrags- und wertorientierte Gespräche mit Kunden und identifizieren gleichzeitig Möglichkeiten zur Erweiterung des bestehenden Geschäfts.

• Sie werden die Therapieadoption in bestehenden Implantationszentren und Herzinsuffizienzkliniken vorantreiben und gleichzeitig neue Wachstumskonten identifizieren und entwickeln.

• Sie werden Empfehlungsnetzwerke in Gemeinde- und Krankenhauseinrichtungen entwickeln und erweitern und verweisende Ärzte und Herzinsuffizienzkliniken engagieren, um den Patientenzugang zu verbessern.

• Sie werden Patientenpfade abbilden, optimieren und unterstützen, die eine frühere Identifizierung, Überwachung und Verwaltung von Patienten mit Herzinsuffizienz ermöglichen.

• Sie arbeiten mit klinischen und nicht-klinischen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Geschäftsfälle zu entwickeln, die die Einführung und Implementierung des CardioMEMS-Service unterstützen.

• Sie analysieren Marktchancen, Patientenpopulationen und Therapielücken, um strategische Wachstumschancen im gesamten Gebiet zu identifizieren.

• Sie werden klinische Ausbildung, Produktschulungen und Therapie-Sensibilisierungsprogramme für Gesundheitsexperten anbieten und Peer-to-Peer-Bildungsinitiativen unterstützen.

• Sie werden Verfahren und Therapie-Implementierung unterstützen, um eine erfolgreiche Integration von CardioMEMS in Herzinsuffizienz Klinik Workflows und Pflegewege zu gewährleisten.

• Sie bieten Kunden fortlaufend technische, klinische und operative Unterstützung und ermöglichen Klinikern, hämodynamische Daten für ein optimiertes Patientenmanagement zu nutzen.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit Marketing-, klinischen und digitalen Teams zusammen, um Kampagnen, Bildungsprogramme, Produkteinführungen und Marktentwicklungsinitiativen durchzuführen.

• Sie pflegen ein genaues Pipeline-Management, Prognosen, CRM-Reporting und stellen die Einhaltung der Unternehmensrichtlinien und regulatorischen Anforderungen sicher.

• Sie vertreten Abbott bei Kundentreffen, wissenschaftlichen Workshops, Bildungsveranstaltungen und relevanten nationalen und internationalen Kongressen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Medizinprodukten, Gesundheitswesen oder kardiovaskulären Verkäufen.

DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI :
À propos d'Abbott
Abbott est un chef de file mondial des soins de santé, créant une science révolutionnaire pour améliorer la santé des gens. Nous sommes toujours tournés vers l'avenir, anticipant les changements dans la science et la technologie médicales.
Dans le domaine de l'insuffisance cardiaque (HF) d'Abbott, nous développons des solutions pour diagnostiquer, surveiller et gérer l'insuffisance cardiaque, permettant ainsi aux gens de rétablir leur santé et de poursuivre leur vie.

La division de l'insuffisance cardiaque d'Abbott en Suisse

Territory Manager Défaillance cardiaque / CardioMEMS - Suisse alémanique
domicile, idéalement situé dans le territoire assigné en Suisse

L'opportunité
Le gestionnaire du territoire est responsable de la croissance durable de l'entreprise AbbottS Heart Faillity par l'expansion de l'adoption de la thérapie CardioMEMS, le développement de réseaux d'implantation et de référence, et l'optimisation des voies de surveillance des patients à distance à travers le territoire. Ce rôle est axé sur l'adoption d'une thérapie à grande échelle, la construction d'écosystèmes d'orientation solides et l'intégration de solutions de surveillance numérique dans la pratique clinique. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants de tous les milieux hospitaliers et ambulatoires, le gestionnaire du territoire positionnera Abbott comme partenaire de confiance dans la gestion de l'insuffisance cardiaque tout en favorisant la croissance commerciale et en améliorant l'accès des patients aux thérapies innovatrices.

Sur quoi vous travaillerez

• Agissant de manière indépendante sur votre territoire, vous serez responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs de vente par la croissance du volume, l'activation de nouveaux comptes et l'expansion de l'utilisation de CardioMEMS.

• Vous développerez et exécuterez des plans globaux de territoire et de compte axés sur l'adoption croissante de la thérapie CardioMEMS et des solutions de télésurveillance.

• Vous établirez et maintenirez des relations solides avec les cardiologues en insuffisance cardiaque, les cliniques en insuffisance cardiaque, les administrateurs d'hôpital et d'autres intervenants clés.

• Vous dirigerez des discussions sur les prix, les contrats et les valeurs avec les clients tout en identifiant les possibilités d'expansion des activités existantes.

At Abbott’s Thoratec Switzerland GmbH , we develop technology that saves lives. As part of Abbott’s global medical device division (115,000+ employees worldwide), we are leaders in implantable and extracorporeal blood pump systems using advanced magnetic levitation technology.

A Abbott’s Thoratec Switzerland GmbH, sviluppiamo tecnologia che salva vite. Come parte della divisione globale di dispositivi medici di Abbott (115.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo), siamo leader nei sistemi di pompaggio del sangue impiantabile e extracorporeo utilizzando la tecnologia avanzata di levitazione magnetica.

Dal nostro sito di Zurigo, un team diversificato di ~130 colleghi collabora con lo sviluppo, la qualità e la produzione per fornire il sistema CentriMag e HeartMate 3, supportando pazienti con insufficienza cardiaca avanzata in tutto il mondo.

Perché questo ruolo è importante

Sei appassionato di promuovere soluzioni sanitarie innovative che danno un impatto significativo sulla vita dei pazienti? In qualità di Design Quality Assurance Manager, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire la qualità, la conformità e l'eccellenza del prodotto durante il ciclo di vita di sviluppo. Lavorando all'intersezione dell'innovazione e della qualità, partnerrai a stretto contatto con i team interfunzionali, tra cui R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Clinical e Project Management, per supportare la fornitura di prodotti sicuri, efficaci e conformi.

In questo ruolo influente, aiuterete a modellare e rafforzare i processi di controllo del design, le pratiche di gestione del rischio e i sistemi di qualità dello sviluppo del prodotto, promuovendo una cultura della collaborazione e del miglioramento continuo. In qualità di partner di qualità affidabile, fornirete una guida strategica per le attività di sviluppo dei prodotti, aiutando i team a gestire i requisiti normativi e le aspettative di qualità, consentendo l'innovazione e la guida di risultati positivi sia per il business che per i pazienti che serviamo.

Cosa farai

• Lead Design Quality Assurance attività durante il ciclo di vita di sviluppo del prodotto.

• Servire come rappresentante di qualità sui team di sviluppo del prodotto interfunzionale. Assicurare l'implementazione e il rispetto dei requisiti di Design Control.

• Guidare attività di pianificazione della qualità per nuovi progetti di sviluppo di prodotti. Fornire la supervisione di qualità per i cambiamenti di progettazione e miglioramenti del prodotto.

• Lead, coach e sviluppare ingegneri di qualità di progettazione e altri professionisti di qualità.

• Stabilire obiettivi di squadra, aspettative di prestazioni e piani di sviluppo. Gestisci la pianificazione delle risorse e la priorità del progetto.

• Promuovere una cultura di qualità, conformità e miglioramento continuo.

Che cosa porta

• Laurea magistrale in scienza, ingegneria o un altro campo tecnico è richiesto.

• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza relativa in un'industria di dispositivi medici.

• Almeno 2 anni di esperienza di gestione delle persone.

• Conoscenza approfondita della norma ISO 13485, requisiti di regolamentazione dei dispositivi medici internazionali (21 CFR parte 820, EU MDD/MDR), MDSAP e altri requisiti regionali applicabili

• Esperienza comprovata che lavora in una grande, globale, organizzazione regolamentata in una posizione di leadership.

• Forte capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder.

• L'esperienza con Design per Six Sigma o Qualità con i metodi di Design sarà considerata un vantaggio forte.

Cosa offriamo

• Un ruolo mirato che contribuisce alle tecnologie salvavita

• Una cultura collaborativa e inclusiva dove vengono valutate diverse prospettive

• Opportunità di crescita e specializzazione (anche diventando una PMI costosa)

• Flessibilità e autonomia nel modo in cui gestisci il tuo lavoro

• Un luogo di lavoro moderno nel cuore di Zurigo

Unisciti a noi

Siamo alla ricerca di individui curiosi e motivati che amano risolvere i problemi, lavorare insieme e fare un impatto.
Se questo suona come te, ci piacerebbe sentire da te.

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, innovative Gesundheitslösungen voranzutreiben, die das Leben der Patienten sinnvoll beeinflussen? Als Design Quality Assurance Manager spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherstellung von Qualität, Compliance und Produktexzellenz während des gesamten Entwicklungslebenszyklus. An der Schnittstelle von Innovation und Qualität arbeiten Sie eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, darunter R & D, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Clinical und Project Management, um die Lieferung sicherer, effektiver und konformer Produkte zu unterstützen.

• Lead Design Quality Assurance Aktivitäten während des gesamten Produktentwicklungslebenszyklus.

Gestionnaire de l'assurance de la qualité de conception – Conduire l'impact dans l'innovation vitale

Lieu: Zurich, Suisse

Chez Abbott. Thoratec Switzerland GmbH, nous développons une technologie qui sauve des vies. Dans le cadre de la division mondiale des dispositifs médicaux d'Abbott, nous sommes les leaders dans les systèmes de pompes sanguines implantables et extracorporelles utilisant la technologie avancée de lévitation magnétique.

De notre site de Zurich, une équipe diversifiée de ~130 collaborateurs collabore au développement, à la qualité et à la production pour fournir le CentriMag System et HeartMate 3 – soutenant les patients souffrant d'insuffisance cardiaque avancée dans le monde entier.

Pourquoi ce rôle est important

Êtes-vous passionné par la promotion de solutions de santé innovantes qui ont un impact significatif sur la vie des patients? En tant que responsable de l'assurance de la qualité du design, vous jouerez un rôle clé en assurant la qualité, la conformité et l'excellence des produits tout au long du cycle de développement. En travaillant à l'intersection de l'innovation et de la qualité, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris la R-D, les affaires réglementaires, la fabrication, la clinique et la gestion de projet, afin d'appuyer la livraison de produits sûrs, efficaces et conformes.

Dans ce rôle influent, vous aiderez à façonner et à renforcer les processus de contrôle de conception, les pratiques de gestion des risques et les systèmes de qualité de développement de produits tout en favorisant une culture de collaboration et d'amélioration continue. En tant que partenaire de qualité fiable, vous fournirez une orientation stratégique pour toutes les activités de développement de produits, aidant les équipes à naviguer sur les exigences réglementaires et les attentes en matière de qualité, tout en favorisant l'innovation et les résultats positifs pour l'entreprise et les patients que nous servons.

Ce que tu vas faire

• Lead Design Activités d'assurance de la qualité tout au long du cycle de développement du produit.

• Servir de représentant de la qualité dans les équipes de développement de produits interfonctionnels. Assurer la mise en oeuvre et la conformité aux exigences de contrôle de la conception.

• Diriger des activités de planification de la qualité pour les nouveaux projets de développement de produits. Assurer la surveillance de la qualité des changements de conception et des améliorations apportées aux produits.

• Dirigez, coachez et développez des ingénieurs de la qualité de conception et d'autres professionnels de la qualité.

• Établir les objectifs de l'équipe, les attentes en matière de rendement et les plans de développement. Gérer la planification des ressources et la hiérarchisation des projets.

• Promouvoir une culture de qualité, de conformité et d'amélioration continue.

Ce que vous apportez

• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience connexe dans une industrie des instruments médicaux.

• Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en gestion des personnes.

Valuta l'allineamento tra struttura organizzativa e strategia aziendale, assicurando che il design supporti priorità attuali e future

• Strategia di Cultura & Attivazione: strategie di implementazione per modellare e sostenere una cultura ad alto rendimento, inclusivo e orientata ai valori. Monitorare la salute culturale attraverso i risultati dell'indagine YVC e le azioni di azionamento per migliorare i dati. Progettare e implementare strategie per migliorare l'impegno dei dipendenti.

• Leadership & Team Effectiveness: Facilitate interventi che migliorano la fiducia, la comunicazione e la collaborazione. Fornire soluzioni di valutazione che migliorano l'efficacia e il coinvolgimento del team. Gestisci Leadership e Team Transitions.

• Change Management & Transformation: Iniziative di gestione dei cambiamenti di piombo costruendo prontezza, resilienza e allineamento. Valutare l'impatto, identificare i rischi, punti di resistenza e lacune di disponibilità. Equip leader e team con gli strumenti e le mentalità necessari per navigare in ambiguità, adattarsi a nuovi modi di lavoro e sostenere le prestazioni durante le transizioni.

• Leadership globale del team: Leader e sviluppare un team globale altamente performante focalizzato sulle iniziative di guida che migliorano le prestazioni organizzative, l'impegno dei dipendenti e l'allineamento culturale. Costruisci partnership forti con BHR DVPs, Sr BHR Area, Business Area Councils (BAC), e Practice Centers. Navigare ambienti matrici complessi per ottenere sponsorizzazione e supporto per OE e iniziative culturali. L'influenza su tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione per guidare l'adozione e l'impatto.

Istruzione

• Laurea in risorse umane, psicologia organizzativa, amministrazione aziendale, o un campo correlato.

• Laurea magistrale in un campo rilevante (ad esempio, sviluppo organizzativo, psicologia organizzativa, amministrazione aziendale).

Esperienza e qualifiche

• 8-10 anni di esperienza progressiva nelle Risorse Umane, con un forte focus sull'OE, la gestione dei cambiamenti e la cultura.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
At Abbott, we're committed to helping people live their best possible life through the power of health. For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve.

Abbott is looking to recruit a

Director of Organizational Effectiveness and Culture, EPD (m/f/d)

Based in Basel, Switzerland (EPD HQ)

The Director of Organizational Effectiveness and Culture plays a strategic leadership role to drive organizational effectiveness and employee engagement by shaping the structures, processes, and cultural practices that enable leaders and teams to thrive. Build resilient and agile teams that are equipped to meet the demands of our dynamic business.

Main Responsibilities

• Organizational Design & Effectiveness: Evaluate and improve organizational strategy success. Lead initiatives to optimize organizational structure, capabilities, roles, and workflows. Evaluates the alignment between organizational structure and business strategy, ensuring that the design supports current and future priorities

• Culture Strategy & Activation: Implement strategies to shape and sustain a high-performing, inclusive, and values-driven culture. Monitor cultural health through YVC survey results and drive actions to improve data. Design and implement strategies to improve employee engagement.

• Leadership & Team Effectiveness: Facilitate interventions that improve trust, communication, and collaboration. Deliver assessment solutions that enhance team effectiveness and engagement. Manage Leadership and Team Transitions.

• Change Management & Transformation: Lead change management initiatives by building readiness, resilience, and alignment. Assess the impact, identify risks, resistance points, and readiness gaps. Equip leaders and teams with the tools and mindsets needed to navigate ambiguity, adapt to new ways of working, and sustain performance during transitions.

• Global Team Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing global team focused on driving initiatives that enhance organizational performance, employee engagement, and cultural alignment. Build strong partnerships with BHR DVPs, Sr BHR Area, Business Area Councils (BAC), and Practice Centers. Navigate complex matrix environments to gain sponsorship and support for OE and cultural initiatives. Influence across all levels of the organization to drive adoption and impact.

Profile Requirements

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in human resources, organizational psychology, business administration, or a related field.

• Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., organizational development, organizational psychology, business administration).

Experience & Qualifications

• 8–10 years of progressive experience in Human Resources, with a strong focus on OE, change management and culture.

• Demonstrates ability to contract, diagnose, design, implement (& pivot), and measure business impact of organization effectiveness and culture solutions.

• 5+ years in a global or enterprise-level leadership role, managing cross-functional or geographically dispersed teams.

• Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders and influence at all levels of the organization.

• Experience working in complex, matrixed environments and navigating global cultural dynamics.

• Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategy into OE solutions.

• Proven experience in team engagement and team effectiveness, assessment, organization effectiveness, and cultural initiatives

• Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills across all organizational levels.

• Demonstrated ability to lead global teams and drive results in a matrixed environment; experience working across diverse g

Abbott will einen

Direktor für Organisationseffektivität und Kultur, EPD (m/w/d)

Sitz in Basel, Schweiz (EPD HQ)

Der Direktor für Organisationseffektivität und Kultur spielt eine strategische Führungsrolle, um die organisatorische Effektivität und das Engagement der Mitarbeiter zu fördern, indem er die Strukturen, Prozesse und kulturellen Praktiken gestaltet, die es Führungskräften und Teams ermöglichen, erfolgreich zu sein. Bauen Sie widerstandsfähige und agile Teams auf, die für die Anforderungen unseres dynamischen Geschäfts gerüstet sind.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Organisationsdesign & Effektivität: Bewerten und verbessern Sie den Erfolg der Organisationsstrategie. Leiten Sie Initiativen zur Optimierung von Organisationsstruktur, Fähigkeiten, Rollen und Workflows. Bewertet die Ausrichtung zwischen Organisationsstruktur und Geschäftsstrategie, um sicherzustellen, dass das Design aktuelle und zukünftige Prioritäten unterstützt

• Kulturstrategie & Aktivierung: Implementieren Sie Strategien, um eine leistungsstarke, integrative und werteorientierte Kultur zu gestalten und zu erhalten. Überwachen Sie die kulturelle Gesundheit durch YVC-Umfrageergebnisse und fördern Sie Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Daten. Entwerfen und implementieren Sie Strategien zur Verbesserung des Mitarbeiterengagements.

• Leadership & Team Effectiveness: Erleichterung von Interventionen, die Vertrauen, Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit verbessern. Liefern Sie Bewertungslösungen, die die Effektivität und das Engagement des Teams verbessern. Verwalten Sie Führung und Teamübergänge.

• Change Management & Transformation: Führen Sie Change Management-Initiativen, indem Sie Bereitschaft, Resilienz und Ausrichtung aufbauen. Beurteilen Sie die Auswirkungen, identifizieren Sie Risiken, Widerstandspunkte und Bereitschaftslücken. Rüsten Sie Führungskräfte und Teams mit den Werkzeugen und Denkweisen aus, die erforderlich sind, um Mehrdeutigkeiten zu steuern, sich an neue Arbeitsweisen anzupassen und die Leistung bei Übergängen aufrechtzuerhalten.

• Globale Teamführung: Führen und entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes globales Team, das sich auf Initiativen konzentriert, die die organisatorische Leistung, das Engagement der Mitarbeiter und die kulturelle Ausrichtung verbessern. Aufbau starker Partnerschaften mit BHR DVPs, Sr BHR Area, Business Area Councils (BAC) und Practice Centers. Navigieren Sie durch komplexe Matrixumgebungen, um Sponsoring und Unterstützung für OE- und Kulturinitiativen zu erhalten. Einfluss auf allen Ebenen der Organisation, um die Akzeptanz und Wirkung zu fördern.

Bildung

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Human Resources, Organisationspsychologie, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Master-Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Organisationsentwicklung, Organisationspsychologie, Betriebswirtschaft).

Erfahrung & Qualifikationen

• 8-10 Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in Human Resources, mit einem starken Fokus auf OE, Change Management und Kultur.

• Demonstriert die Fähigkeit zur Kontraktion, Diagnose, Design, Implementierung (und Pivot) und Messung der Geschäftsauswirkungen von Organisationseffektivität und Kulturlösungen.

• 5+ Jahre in einer globalen oder unternehmensweiten Führungsrolle, Verwaltung von funktionsübergreifenden oder geografisch verteilten Teams.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, mit leitenden Führungskräften und Einfluss auf allen Ebenen der Organisation zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Erleben Sie die Arbeit in komplexen, matrixförmigen Umgebungen und navigieren Sie durch globale kulturelle Dynamiken.

• Starker Geschäftssinn mit der Fähigkeit, Strategie in OE-Lösungen zu übersetzen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Team-Engagement und Team-Effektivität, Bewertung, Organisationseffektivität und kulturellen Initiativen

• Außergewöhnliches Stakeholder-Management und Einfluss auf Fähigkeiten auf allen organisatorischen Ebenen.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, globale Teams zu führen und Ergebnisse in einer matrixförmigen Umgebung zu erzielen; Erfahrung in verschiedenen Bereichen

DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI:
Chez Abbott, nous sommes déterminés à aider les gens à vivre leur meilleure vie grâce au pouvoir de la santé. Depuis plus de 125 ans, nous avons apporté de nouveaux produits et technologies dans le monde en nutrition, diagnostic, dispositifs médicaux et médicaments génériques de marque qui créent plus de possibilités pour plus de personnes à tous les stades de la vie. Aujourd'hui, 114 000 d'entre nous travaillent pour aider les gens à vivre non seulement plus longtemps, mais mieux, dans plus de 160 pays que nous servons.

Abbott cherche à recruter

Directeur de l'efficacité organisationnelle et de la culture, EPD (h/f/d)

Basé à Bâle, Suisse (HQ EPD)

Le directeur de l'efficacité organisationnelle et de la culture joue un rôle de leadership stratégique pour stimuler l'efficacité organisationnelle et l'engagement des employés en façonnant les structures, les processus et les pratiques culturelles qui permettent aux dirigeants et aux équipes de prospérer. Construisez des équipes résilientes et agiles qui sont équipées pour répondre aux exigences de notre activité dynamique.

Principales responsabilités

• Conception et efficacité organisationnelles: Évaluer et améliorer le succès de la stratégie organisationnelle. Diriger les initiatives pour optimiser la structure organisationnelle, les capacités, les rôles et les flux de travail. Évaluer l'alignement entre la structure organisationnelle et la stratégie opérationnelle, en veillant à ce que la conception appuie les priorités actuelles et futures

• Stratégie et activation culturelles: Mettre en oeuvre des stratégies pour façonner et maintenir une culture à haut rendement, inclusive et axée sur les valeurs. Surveiller la santé culturelle à l'aide des résultats de l'enquête sur les CEVJ et mener des actions pour améliorer les données. Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies pour améliorer l'engagement des employés.

• Leadership et efficacité de l'équipe: Faciliter les interventions qui améliorent la confiance, la communication et la collaboration. Fournir des solutions d'évaluation qui améliorent l'efficacité et l'engagement de l'équipe. Gérer le leadership et les transitions d'équipe.

• Gestion et transformation du changement: Diriger les initiatives de gestion du changement en renforçant la préparation, la résilience et l'alignement. Évaluer l'impact, identifier les risques, les points de résistance et les lacunes de préparation. Équiper les dirigeants et les équipes des outils et des mentalités nécessaires pour naviguer dans l'ambiguïté, s'adapter aux nouvelles façons de travailler et maintenir les performances pendant les transitions.

• Leadership de l'équipe mondiale: Dirigez et développez une équipe mondiale à haut rendement axée sur les initiatives qui améliorent le rendement organisationnel, l'engagement des employés et l'alignement culturel. Établir de solides partenariats avec les DVP de la BHR, le Secteur de la BHR, les conseils des secteurs d'activité et les centres de pratique. Naviguer dans des environnements matriciels complexes pour obtenir des commandites et un soutien pour les initiatives culturelles et d'OT. Influence à tous les niveaux de l'organisation pour favoriser l'adoption et l'impact.

Exigences relatives au profil

Éducation

• Baccalauréat en ressources humaines, psychologie organisationnelle, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.

• Maîtrise dans un domaine pertinent (par exemple, développement organisationnel, psychologie organisationnelle, administration des affaires).

Expérience et qualifications

• De 8 à 10 ans d'expérience progressive en ressources humaines, l'accent étant mis sur l'OT, la gestion du changement et la culture.

• Démontre la capacité de contracter, de diagnostiquer, de concevoir, de mettre en oeuvre (& pivot) et de mesurer l'impact opérationnel des solutions d'efficacité et de culture de l'organisation.

• 5 ans et plus dans un rôle de leadership mondial ou d'entreprise, la gestion d'équipes interfonctionnelles ou géographiquement dispersées.

• Capacité démontrée de travailler en partenariat avec des cadres supérieurs et d'exercer une influence à tous les niveaux de l'organisation.

• Expérience de travail dans des environnements complexes et matriciaux et de navigation de la dynamique culturelle mondiale.

• Forte entreprise avec la capacité de traduire la stratégie en solutions OE.

• Expérience éprouvée en matière d'engagement et d'efficacité de l'équipe, d'évaluation, d'efficacité organisationnelle et d'initiatives culturelles

• Gestion exceptionnelle des intervenants et influence des compétences à tous les niveaux organisationnels.

• Capacité démontrée de diriger des équipes mondiales et d'obtenir des résultats dans un environnement matriciel; expérience de travail à travers divers g

JOB DESCRIPTION:
About Abbott
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Abbott's Diagnostics division in Switzerland is looking for a

Sales and Customer Support Specialist
based in Baar

The Opportunity
The position of Sales and Customer Support Specialist is within our Business Unit Shared Services located at Abbott Rapid Diagnostics GmbH Switzerland, Baar. This role will support the sales team by being in close contact with customers and sales Team.

Responsibilities and Duties

• For your customers, you represent the interface to other internal service areas (customer service, technical customer service)

• The role is responsible for a variety of sales support and order processing functions for internal and external customers to facilitate business objectives

• The focus is on quantitative point-of-care rapid tests

• The role will partly contain Customer Care and follow ups for Campaigns

• This role will monitor contract management and support the sales team for customer care

• Maintenance of the CRM System

• Direct support would include dealing with inbound customer contact (i.e. enquiries, complaints, placing orders), order processing, order management/status, outbound contact, updating customers on orders

• Dealing with non-technical complaints or enquiries (i.e. late shipment, back order)

• Indirect support would include preparation of tenders and contracts and reports for the sales organisation

• Use of computerised system for tracking and information gathering related to order management

Requirements

• Ideally you have experience to work with Health Care Professionals or knowing the world of Primary Care

• Fluent in German, English basic language skills required. Other swiss languages welcome

• High service and customer orientation.

• Preferrably you already have experience in the field of diabetology and the processes in a specialized diabetology practice

• Flexibility, adaptability and a positive approach to change

• Willingness to develop permanently

• 2-3 years work experience in Customer Service, previous customer service experience in the healthcare industry preferred

• We are looking for an analytically thinking personality who can organize himself very well, has excellent communication skills and pursues his goals with perseverance.

• proficient in MS Word, Excel and Outlook

• SAP or other ERP system experience a significant advantage

Competencies

• Very good organizational skills and flair to collaborate with a dynamic sales organization

• Good communication and interpersonal skills

• Demonstrated ability to maintain positive people relationships and build strong links with all departments

• Possesses flexibility and ability to work under pressure in a fast-changing environment and ambiguous situations

• Team player with a high level of initiative, energy and enthusiasm

• Challenge-minded with a high persuasive power

• Driven by objectives, solutions, meet the deadlines and customer satisfaction

Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters and help people to live a healthier and full life, grow your career, and learn, be your true self. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of

• Competitive compensations and benefits

• A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

• A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to w

jobs.title: Director, Global Alliances - Biosimilars & Biologics (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
At Abbott, we're committed to helping people live their best possible life through the power of health. For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve.

Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) is looking to recruit a

Director, Global Alliances - Biosimilars & Biologics (m/f/d)

Based at the EPD HQ in Basel, Switzerland

Primary Job Function:

Lead the strategic management of Global Biosimilars & Biologics alliances with EPD licensing partners, serving as the primary interface to ensure strong collaboration, effective governance, and successful execution of supply and commercialization agreements across global EPD markets. Support the identification and negotiation of new licensing opportunities that enhance the biosimilars pipeline and advance the EPD Biologics growth strategy. Responsible for maximizing partnership value, managing alliance performance, and coordinating cross-functional efforts to deliver business objectives and contractual commitments.

Core Job Responsibilities

Alliance Management & Strategic Partnerships

• Serve as the primary relationship manager and executive point of contact for strategic biologics/biosimilars, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and collaboration across all relevant functions within EPD and partner organizations.

• Build, maintain, and expand strategic alliances with external partners to maximize the value of existing licensing agreements and support long-term portfolio expansion across global EPD markets.

• Establish robust governance frameworks with partners, including regular business reviews, joint steering committees, and performance monitoring to ensure successful execution of partnership objectives.

• Lead the management of partner relationships, proactively identifying opportunities, mitigating risks, and resolving issues to ensure sustainable and mutually beneficial collaborations.

Business Development & Licensing

• Provide leadership in alliance management, business development, and partnership strategy to support the growth objectives of the EPD Global Biologics portfolio.

• Support the execution of the Global Biologics strategy by identifying, evaluating, and engaging high-quality developers and partners, and by negotiating and executing licensing agreements in collaboration with License & Acquisitions (L&A) and other key stakeholders.

• Identify unmet business needs and portfolio gaps that can be addressed through strategic partnerships, licensing opportunities, acquisitions, or other external collaborations.

• Lead and support partner evaluations, due diligence activities, business case development, and internal approval processes for licensing-in opportunities.

• Identify and execute new business development opportunities by coordinating cross-functional requirements, business case submissions, governance approvals, and contract negotiations.

Portfolio Growth & Commercial Execution

• Drive the expansion of the Global Biologics portfolio by securing partnerships that strengthen the pipeline and support EPD's long-term Biologics growth strategy.

• Develop and maintain strategic sourcing partnerships across Europe, India, Asia, Latin America, and other key regions to ensure sustainable access to Biologics and Biosimilars.

• Define and implement annual business plans with strategic partners to support country and regional growth objectives, product launches, and portfolio optimization.

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful execution of all licensing, supply, commercialization, and development agreements.
