jobs.title: Category Manager Procurement
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
About Abbott

At Abbott, we believe people live their fullest lives when they are healthy — physically, emotionally, and socially. As a global healthcare leader with over 107,000 colleagues in 160+ countries , we create lifechanging technologies that support health at every stage of life.

Within our Branded Generics business , we make trusted, high quality medicines accessible to more than 18 million people every day , particularly in fast growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets. Our diverse portfolio spans critical therapeutic areas including Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory — addressing real, unmet patient needs worldwide.

Abbott is a place where science, purpose, and people come together — and where diverse perspectives are essential to building better outcomes for patients.

Primary Job Function:

• Responsible for developing and implementing global supplier relationship strategies supporting all financial, operational, qualitative, and regulatory aspects.

• Develop supply market insight capability within the GPROC (Global Procurement) organization to increase knowledge of supply market dynamics, composition, trends and gain a comprehensive understanding of the market landscape and business models from a macro and micro economic perspective covering and Procurement. And utilize this to build and maintain Procurement strategies.

• Monitor supply market dynamics across peer organizations also for benchmarking purposes.

• Focus on achieving LRP Supplier Relationship Office related savings

• Drive annual performance improvements via strategy work and applicable metrics.

• Build up and maintain supplier relationship experience roadmap and ensure that processes meet and reflect EPD overall expectations

• Facilitate and communicate the global supplier landscape design, implementation, optimization and integration of the flow of materials and the related financials

• Assist in analysing of all Supplier Cost within EPD PTO (Procurement & TPM Organization)

• Ensure that impacts to operations driven by regulatory requirements are minimized and/or leveraged for competitive advantage

• Support the Snr Global Supplier Relationship Director to deliver specific strategic projects and initiatives

Core Job Responsibilities:

• Direct, plan and execute strategic GPROC programs, including re-engineering of supplier base on a global or regional basis. Focusing on Cost and Supply Chain continuity.

• Support optimization of the EPD GPROC supplier structure to expand our global supplier network, improve supplier compliance and efficiency

• Actively pursue a cross-functional culture of excellence to effectively implement global supplier programs

• Align programs with Operations and other EPD Functional areas on goals and objectives for the global supplier process

• Build and maintain close working relationships with and provide expertise to management to identify and realize improvements

• Effective cross functional and divisional stakeholder communication, collaboration and coordination

• Lead and/or support large scale and sustainable change management initiatives

• Be a key leader in influencing the evolving EPD GPROC supplier strategy

• Support global supplier integration and acquisitions

• Stay abreast of supplier related regulatory requirements, providing expertise to project teams to ensure cost-effective compliance

Minimum Education:

• Bachelor's degree and/or comparable educational background required. Graduate degree or professional certification is preferred (MBA, CPA, etc.)

Minimum Experience/Training Required:

Experience :

• 5- 10 years of global supply chain and procurement experience

• Management experience (team and project management) preferably in the pharmaceutical industry

• Experience in managing large distribution and transportation budgets

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel, with high-level w

• Identificare e migliorare il processo di azionamento, compresa la creazione e il miglioramento continuo dei rapporti standard / strumenti

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli e alla precisione con un occhio attento a fare scadenze

• Führen Sie spezifische Finanzberichte (wie EPD vs. Market, Price, Investor Relations und Board of Directors), um Einblicke für die Kunden zu generieren

• Konsolidierung und Analyse von Finanzdaten, Gewährleistung einer korrekten und pünktlichen Übermittlung von Managementpaketen und Unternehmensvorlagen

• Bereiten Sie Finanzmodelle vor und erstellen Sie Ad-hoc-Analysen, wie von der Geschäftsleitung gefordert, um die Zuverlässigkeit und Genauigkeit der bereitgestellten Finanzinformationen zu gewährleisten

À propos d'Abbott

Chez Abbott , nous croyons que les gens vivent pleinement leur vie quand ils sont en bonne santé — physiquement, émotionnellement et socialement . En tant que leader mondial des soins de santé avec plus de 107 000 collègues dans plus de 160 pays, nous développons des médicaments et des technologies qui changent la vie et qui soutiennent la santé à tous les stades de la vie.

Dans le cadre de nos activités de Branded Generics , nous rendons des médicaments de haute qualité et de confiance accessibles à plus de 18 millions de personnes chaque jour , en particulier dans les régions à croissance rapide comme LATAM, APAC, Inde et Marchés émergents . Notre portefeuille diversifié couvre des domaines thérapeutiques critiques, y compris la santé des femmes, la gastroentérologie, le cardiométabolique, le SNC et la douleur, et respiratoire, répondant aux besoins réels et souvent non satisfaits des patients dans le monde entier.

Abbott est un endroit où la science, le but et les gens se réunissent, et où des perspectives diversifiées et un leadership inclusif sont essentiels pour obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour les patients à l'échelle mondiale.
Votre impact

Fonction principale :

En tant que membre de l'équipe des FP&A, l'analyste financier principal s'associera pour diriger les finances de la DPE d'Abbott en gérant le processus de planification et en générant des idées sur nos marchés et nos filiales. Il/elle sera responsable de la qualité et de l'actualité des rapports et des présentations financiers, dirigera l'analyse financière ad hoc et jouera un rôle actif dans le maintien et l'amélioration des processus de FP&A.

Responsabilités essentielles au travail :

• Analyser les données financières et diriger le processus de planification du PDE

• Organiser les données dans des rapports accessibles et effectuer divers types d'analyse à l'aide de mesures clés / Préparer des rapports de gestion périodiques

• Prendre un rôle clé dans la préparation RLBE

• Fournir des modèles financiers et des prévisions.

Responsabilité et portée du poste :

• Diriger le processus de planification de la DPE, y compris la préparation d'orientations et d'outils, communiquer activement avec les principaux intervenants et prévoir les défis et les possibilités

• Diriger des rapports financiers spécifiques (tels que EPD vs Market, Price, Investor Relations et Conseil d'administration), générer des informations pour les clients

• Consolider et analyser les données financières, en veillant à l'exactitude et au respect des délais de présentation des dossiers de gestion et des modèles ministériels

• Préparer des modèles financiers et générer des analyses ponctuelles selon les besoins de la haute direction, en assurant la fiabilité et l'exactitude des informations financières fournies

• Identifier et diriger les améliorations des processus, y compris la création et l'amélioration continue des rapports et des outils normalisés

Éducation minimale:

• Baccalauréat en finance, administration des affaires, comptabilité ou équivalent. Le MBA est un atout

Exigences relatives à l'emploi :

• 3-5 ans d'expérience en finance d'entreprise, planification financière & analyse, ou d'autres domaines connexes Excellentes compétences analytiques et bon raisonnement numérique

• Forte connaissance pratique d'Excel

• Capacité de communiquer et d'influencer efficacement dans une matrice et au niveau de la haute direction

• Une grande attention aux détails et à la précision avec un regard attentif sur l'établissement des délais

• Un penseur critique, hautement collaboratif et capable de travailler sur le plan fonctionnel

• Travailler de manière efficace et indépendante

• Très bonne maîtrise de l'anglais écrit et parlé

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy & Partnerships

Abbott | Established Pharmaceuticals Division

Make a Meaningful Difference for Patients Worldwide

At Abbott , we believe people can live fuller lives through better health. Every day, our medicines and technologies help millions of people around the world manage health conditions, overcome barriers to care, and achieve better outcomes.

Within our Branded Generics business, we provide trusted, high-quality medicines to more than 18 million people daily across Latin America, Asia-Pacific, India, and other emerging markets. Our portfolio spans areas including Women's Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic Health, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory Care , helping address some of healthcare's most pressing needs.

We are looking for a collaborative, purpose-driven leader to help strengthen the voice of patients across our organization and create meaningful partnerships that improve patient experiences and outcomes globally.
About the Opportunity

As Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy & Partnerships , you will play a key role in shaping how Abbott listens to, learns from, and collaborates with patients and patient organizations around the world.
This is a unique opportunity to build and evolve a global patient engagement capability, connecting patient insights with strategic decision making across Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory Affairs, Public Affairs, and Commercial teams.

You will work with colleagues across regions and functions to ensure patient perspectives help inform healthcare solutions, policy discussions, evidence generation, and access initiatives. Most importantly, you will help create lasting partnerships that improve outcomes for patients and communities.

What You'll Do

Shape Abbott's Global Patient Strategy

• Develop and advance a patient-centered engagement strategy across the organization

• Help integrate patient perspectives into business, medical, and access decisions

• Advise senior stakeholders on evolving patient needs, healthcare trends, and opportunities to improve patient experiences

• Promote patient trust as a cornerstone of responsible healthcare leadership

Build Meaningful Partnerships

• Develop and nurture relationships with patient organizations, advocacy groups, and patient leaders

• Create long-term collaborations around education, support programs, evidence generation, and healthcare improvement initiatives

• Foster trust-based partnerships that create shared value for patients and healthcare systems

Bring Patient Insights into Action

• Establish approaches to gather and translate patient insights into meaningful recommendations

• Partner with Medical Affairs and Market Access teams to ensure patient experiences inform evidence generation and value-based initiatives

• Help strengthen understanding of real-world patient challenges and outcomes

Support Advocacy and Healthcare System Improvement

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on patient-centered policy and advocacy initiatives

• Contribute to discussions that improve access to care and reduce barriers to treatment

• Help elevate the patient voice within healthcare ecosystems globally

Drive Excellence and Capability Building

• Develop frameworks, guidance, and best practices for patient engagement across Abbott

• Champion patient-centered ways of working across teams and regions

• Support colleagues in building capabilities and confidence in patient partnership approaches

Act as an Ambassador for Patient-Centered Healthcare

• Represent Abbott at industry meetings, scientific congresses, and patient advocacy forums

• Help strengthen Abbott's reputation as a trusted partner within the patient community

• Share insights and best practices that advance patient engagement across the broader healthcare landscape

What You'll Bring

We're interested in individuals who are passionate about improving patient outcomes

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Thoratec Switzerland GmbH is a part of Abbott Laboratories , one of the world's leading manufacturers of medical devices. We are the global market leader for implantable and extracorporeal blood pumps based on magnetic levitation technology. Our life-saving systems, which we develop and manufacture in Zurich, are used for acute and long-term therapy in patients with severe heart diseases.

Our location in the city of Zurich has around 130 employees in the areas of development and production of the Centri MagTM system and the HeartMate 3TM motor.

As we grow our current team, we are looking for a passionate, open minded and down to earth person to join our team.

(Senior) Electrical Engineer

The open position is within the Manufacturing Engineering – Equipment Engineering team. The Equipment Engineering team works together with Maintenance Engineering and First Level Support teams to assure availability and compliance of our Test Equipment.

In this function you will:

• Be responsible to build and qualify Electrical Test Equipment to assure production continuity

• Depending on priorities, responsible to design new Electrical Test Equipment, conducting Equipment/Non-product Software and Test Method validation activities

• Take ownership for equipment availability and repair

• Support the whole equipment lifecycle

• Support equipment related corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities

Desired Profile:

• Background: Electrical Engineering

• 3+ experience as an electrical engineer preferable

• Good knowledge of electrical circuit design

• Experience in trouble-shooting electrical equipment

• Software knowhow, at best C# and Python, experience with OpenHTF is a plus

• Experience with debugging Software

• Experience with EIQ/EOQ & NPS validation is an asset

• Fluent in English (written and spoken), German would be an asset

We are offering opportunities for development for a highly motivated specialist who thinks along and enjoys being part of a small, young team with broad responsibilities. Do you have what it takes? Then send us your application including motivation, curriculum vitae, letter of recommendation and diplomas in PDF format today. We are looking forward to meeting you.

The base pay for this position is
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.
